cameron fillardi.name: Cameron Fillardi
cameron fillardi.origin: Cameron Fillardi was the godson of Sheriff Harry O'Connor who had forced himself upon Monica Brezzi and her family moved away. (Though unclear, the Sheriff may have protected his godson from legal trouble). He later went on a date with Emily Stouffer and when they returned home, he drove past her house and he threatened to sexually assault her. However before he could he was killed by Jack O'Lantern. His body was returned as one of Jack O'Lantern's Zombies and used to attack the Sheriff but the Sheriff managed to overcome him and "killed" him again.

cameron hodge.name: Cameron Hodge
cameron hodge.species: Human transformed into a Techno-Organic (Phalanx)/Human hybrid, later resurrected by the Techno-Organic Virus; Head immortalized by demon deal; Cyborg body
cameron hodge.origin: ===Early years=== Cameron Hodge was the roommate of Warren Worthington III in college. Worthington was under the impression that they were good friends at first, but actually, Hodge was insanely jealous of Worthington's good looks, prestige, and wealth. When Worthington was later publicly revealed as Angel, the mutant hero and member of the Defenders, it only fueled his hatred. All those feelings attributed to Worthington were transferred to include all mutants, whom Hodge came to believe were a threat to the freedom of normal humans and therefore should be destroyed. ===The Right=== Hodge became a lawyer, but then turned to advertising and public relations and became a highly successful member of a leading New York City advertising agency. Meanwhile, he secretly created an organization devoted to the destruction of all mutants, the Right. Hodge was the leader of the group and was known as the Commander. ===X-Factor=== Worthington, still believing that Hodge was his friend, turned to him to help with coming up with a way to combat the growing prejudice against mutants. They came up with idea for the original X-Factor. The original members of the X-Men, the Beast, Cyclops, Marvel Girl, and Iceman agreed to join the group. X-Factor's concept-- a group of supposed mutant hunters who would in fact make contact with mutants and train them in the use of their powers-- quickly backfired on the group. It actually intensified people's hatred of mutants, just as Hodge had planned. Unknown to the rest of X-Factor, Hodge arranged for the Right to kidnap the young mutant known as Rictor in hopes of creating an earthquake that could be blamed on mutants, but X-Factor foiled their scheme and rescued Rictor. He also contacted a genetic engineer, Dr. Frederick Animus, who later became known as the Ani-Mator, and commissioned him to find a way to prevent mutations from occurring. Instead, Animus defied his employer's orders and created the "Ani-Mates." The Right arrived on the scene to discipline the defiant Animus, and ended up battling the Ani-Mates and their allies, the New Mutants. Ultimately, the New Mutant, Magik, transported all of the Right to the dimension of Limbo, but Hodge narrowly escaped that fate. When the Angel's wings were damaged in a fight with the Marauders, Hodge secretly arranged to have the damaged wings amputated. Then, he convinced Warren Worthington to change his will, to give most of his fortune to X-Factor if he were to die, with Hodge as the executor of the estate. Soon after, Worthington seemingly committed suicide in an airplane that exploded, and Hodge controlled the Worthington fortune. By now, the other members of X-Factor had realized that Hodge was their enemy. They engaged the Right in a battle and learned that Hodge was actually the leader of the group. Although he escaped, the Right were dealt a crippling blow and have yet to recover. ===Inferno=== Cameron Hodge later made a pact with the demon N'astirh. He would provide it with mutant babies for his scheme to invade Earth with demons, and Hodge was told that he would not die in his next battle with the mutants. He was granted the gift of immortality. Warren Worthington's fiancée, Candy Southern, was kidnapped by Hodge, who killed her to get back at Worthington, who was now Archangel. At the end of that battle, Archangel's new metallic wings beheaded Hodge, possibly against his volition. ===X-Tinction Agenda=== Because of his immortality, Cameron Hodge did not die, but made his way to the island of Genosha, then a mutant-repressive nation. Hodge gained an influential governmental position, and his head was now attached to the form of a large mechanical spider with a myriad of mechanical powers. He lured all the mutants from the X-Men, X-Factor, and New Mutants teams to Genosha, where he would be able either to subjugate or kill all of them. Among his first captives was the alien Warlock, and Hodge attempted to siphon off his shape-shifting power so he could change his spider-form at will. His plan seemed to be thwarted by Warlock's friend Wolfsbane, but Warlock died anyway. It became apparent to the government of Genosha as well as to the mutants that Hodge was planning to take over the island and use it as his base for the extermination of all mutants. Hodge's body was destroyed by the brothers Cyclops and Havok, and he was buried during the collapse of a skyscraper. ===Phalanx Covenant=== Hodge nonetheless survived, due to his partial success in siphoning Warlock's powers. Hodge now possessed powers similar to Warlock's "techno-organic" physiology, which allowed him to absorb other people and technology into himself. Eventually, he and the mutant haters he absorbed evolved and joined into the collective race known as the Phalanx (an offshoot of the alien Technarchy race of which Warlock was a part). The new Phalanx assimilated a number of people, including loved ones of the X-Men, while clashing with the X-Men at various times. The Ph

fields.trivia: The Ruby Quartz armor that Hodge wore became flawed after Iceman froze the exterior, and Cyclops was able to exploit that weakness, although it was revealed to be an android double of Hodge. Hodge's "mutants killed" count was 178 as of . It is unknown if that correspond to the total of mutants he personally killed, or also those killed by his organization. After Krakoa became a sovereign nation state for mutants, Cameron Hodge was considered to be the sixth most deadly threat to mutants, and was responsible for 178 mutant deaths.

cameron leonard.name: Cameron Leonard
cameron leonard.origin: After Blue Shield failed to stop the Omnivore, he decided to resign as head of security for Project Pegasus. Firebolt was hired to take his place. After a series of sabotages involving experiments, Dr. Jeannine O'Connell realizes who was behind them, at which point she was confronted by Firebolt, who threatened to kill her. Arriving at that point, Blue Shield confronted the villain, who revealed he had been working for Roxxon Oil all along. Firebolt attempted to kill Blue Shield, but Blue Shield placed a protective bubble around Firebolt, holding in his continued plasma bursts. Eventually, the heat became too great, and Firebolt was reduced to slag.

cameron palmer.name: Cameron Palmer
cameron palmer.origin: Cameron Palmer was Kiden Nixon's teacher. One day at school, a student Kiden had had a fight with brought a gun to school and tried to shoot her, but Kiden used her powers to slow time and dodge the bullet, and Cameron was shot instead. Six months later, Cameron, despite having survived, had quit her job and fallen into a depression worsened by her recent divorce. She attempted suicide, but was found and saved by Kiden, who had run away from home after the incident. After recovering in the hospital, Kiden told Cameron she was a mutant, but she didn't believe her and ordered her to return home to her mother. That night, Kiden left to find the hotel where X-23 was prostituting herself and Cameron found the address in her notebook and followed her there. They both found X-23 cutting herself over the body of a client who committed suicide in front of her. The trio fled and Kiden explained how she saw the ghost of her father and he told her to find Cameron and X-23. In Cameron's apartment, Kiden saw her father's ghost warn her to flee with the Cameron and X-23, as the latter's pimp Zebra Daddy and his henchmen were targeting her for supposedly killing a john. They fled to the streets and later collided with Tatiana, a young mutant running to escape harassment from a crowd of humans. The crowd fled when Tatiana achieved a monstrous cat form, but X-23 managed to calm her down and regress back to her true form. In the Bronx, the group caught Tatiana up on everything. Several days later, Cameron cruelly told Kiden she blamed her for the misery in her life and even told her her mother was better off without her. Cameron later apologized. At that point, Kiden had another vision of her father warned Cameron that they had to get back to her apartment. While the other waited outside of her building, Cameron entered her apartment and was ambushed on one of Zebra Daddy's henchmen. Outside, Kiden again saw her father's ghost, accompanied by Bobby Soul, who warned her that it was a trap and told her to go with Bobby. Hearing Cameron screaming inside, the group was suddenly attacked by Zebra Daddy and more of his henchmen, but X-23 killed several of them, and heard more screaming from Cameron. Back inside, Cameron struggled with the henchman, and in the conflict threw him and herself out the window. Tatiana, in her cat form, caught her. Dangling from the building wall, Cameron witnessed Zebra Daddy gun down and seemingly kill X-23 before her sleeve ripped and she fell. Kiden then froze time, realizing Zebra Daddy was her father's killer, and almost killed him but instead chose to push a mattress under Cameron to cushion her fall. After Kiden unfroze time, Cameron fell unharmed to the ground. Zebra Daddy put a gun to Kiden's head, but was killed by X-23 before he could shoot her. Bobby beckoned the young women to come with him where they could be safe and they reluctantly agreed and followed him to his apartment.

Several days later, Cameron cruelly told Kiden she blamed her for the misery in her life and even told her her mother was better off without her. Cameron later apologized. At that point, Kiden had another vision of her father warned Cameron that they had to get back to her apartment. While the other waited outside of her building, Cameron entered her apartment and was ambushed on one of Zebra Daddy's henchmen. Outside, Kiden again saw her father's ghost, accompanied by Bobby Soul, who warned her that it was a trap and told her to go with Bobby. Hearing Cameron screaming inside, the group was suddenly attacked by Zebra Daddy and more of his henchmen, but X-23 killed several of them, and heard more screaming from Cameron. Back inside, Cameron struggled with the henchman, and in the conflict threw him and herself out the window. Tatiana, in her cat form, caught her. Dangling from the building wall, Cameron witnessed Zebra Daddy gun down and seemingly kill X-23 before her sleeve ripped and she fell. Kiden then froze time, realizing Zebra Daddy was her father's killer, and almost killed him but instead chose to push a mattress under Cameron to cushion her fall. After Kiden unfroze time, Cameron fell unharmed to the ground. Zebra Daddy put a gun to Kiden's head, but was killed by X-23 before he could shoot her. Bobby beckoned the young women to come with him where they could be safe and they reluctantly agreed and followed him to his apartment.

camila rivera.name: Camila Rivera
camila rivera.origin: Camila Rivera left her position at S.H.I.E.L.D. after the Hydra takeover. She joined the Sentinel program in search of a path forward after a terminal diagnosis. Empowered by nanotechnology, rifleman Sawtooth became part of Larry Trask's Fireteam. Deployed around the world, she helped the team capture Omega Red in Russia. On a mission to take Sebastian Shaw into custody, she helped shield explosives specialist Voivod from the mutant’s fury before new teammate Drumfire downed their opponent. In Madripoor Sawtooth crafted a connection to teammate Voivod, who began to graft with his enhancements after a fierce battle in Madripoor and was kept for study. Hearing him through the door of his cell, she trusted her teammates’ statements about a deeper truth behind the grafting process and broke him out of the prison. Voivod led her to the nearby holding place of Juston Seyfert, the sentience behind the graft, but was killed by Bloodhounds en route. Beginning to graft, Sawtooth nevertheless worked to free Juston from his containment tube before an upgraded Lockstep blasted her right hand, sent to subdue her by Warden Ellis. Raising her remaining hand to stop him killing Juston, she enraged the team leader who threw her from the building, yelling at her as he pursued. Lockstep was struck down by a Sentinel piloted by Drumfire, sent to help save Juston by Charles Xavier. Sawtooth crawled back and freed Juston, who stopped the rampaging Lockstep, albeit unable to restore the man within the machine. Juston and the remaining members of the Fireteam joined together inside the Sentinel, fleeing the program and chasing a new future together.

camila vazquez.name: Camila Vázquez
camila vazquez.origin: Camila Vázquez owned and ran Pana Fuerte, a Puerto Rican based restaurant in Harlem. When Camila and her business neighbors were robbed, she went down to the shipping center to check it out. She got into an argument with the thieves and she was kidnapped. Spider-Man was able to rescue her. After he was able to retrieve their inventories, she offered him free food. She was later present for the death of Tinkerer, where he learned that Spider-Man was one of her neighbors.

camille benally.name: Camille Benally
camille benally.origin: ===Origin & Drax=== Camille "Cammi" Benally was an average, 10-year-old human girl with an absent father and an abusive alcoholic of a mother in the small town of Coot's Bluff, Alaska. She encountered Drax the Destroyer when a prison ship he was on board crash landed on Earth just outside of her town. Cammi befriended Drax and protected Coot's Bluff from Paibok, Lunatik, and the Blood Brothers. During the battle, Drax gained a new body. A second prison ship later arrived and arrested both Drax and Cammi. 100px|thumb|left|Cammi After arriving on Xandar, Cammi joined with Drax, Nova, and the other Guardians of the Galaxy to take on Annihilus and his Wave. ===Murderworld=== After the Annihilation War, Cammi separated from Drax and became a space bandit. For eighteen months, she committed crimes against the Badoon, Kree, Shi'ar, and several others planets, races, and empires. She was eventually apprehended by S.W.O.R.D. while stealing from a Shi'ar Warhawk. Cammi was interrogated by Special Agent Abigail Brand, who offered to "lose" her and return her to Earth rather than extradite her to another's jurisdiction. Cammi adamantly requested not to be returned to Earth, but before the interrogation could progress further, Cammi was abducted by Arcade. Along with fifteen other young superheroes, Cammi was brought to Murderworld by Arcade for an all out death match. Cammi almost immediately separated from the others and began setting traps and spying on other camps to protect herself. She formed a temporary alliance with Darkhawk before he disappeared, and was saved by Nico and Chase of the Runaways, with whom she formed an alliance. thumb|150px|Cammi as "Cammihawk" From then on she struggled to keep the peace among the other participants and was forced to take Chase by surprise and break his leg so that she could remove the Darkhawk amulet from him and stop Nico from killing Cullen Bloodstone. Chase stopped the battle between them because Hazmat was losing control over her powers and was going to explode. Reptil turned into a dinosaur form to carry Hazmat out into the water away from everyone else. Apex tried to attack all the remaining survivors with the entire arsenal that Arcade had at his disposal, and because Chase was immobilized, Cammi returned the Darkhawk amulet to him to make him able to fight again. After Death Locket killed Apex, the survivors were rescued and were treated by paramedics and Avengers while Cammi was treated by agent Abigail Brand. ===Undercover=== Over the course of the next few months Camille would try her best to blend in with normal society, having gotten back together with her mother Mavis. The weight of mundane living was slowly eating away at her sense of self, however as she would regularly sit through her parent's personal help talk meetings in order to make her family reunion work. Eventually however her longing for adventure and redemption would lead her to seek out the other surviving teen heroes in response to Cullen's more erratic behavior posted on the web. thumb|left|250px|Cammi undercover Worried about their brother in battle, she and the rest of them reconnoitered back at House Bloodstone to check up on him after Anachronism sent out the call when he last lost sight of Cullen, still broken and bitterly obsessed with revenge. The crew tracked down his last whereabouts near of Bagalia City, where his latest video showed him leaping into a pit without wearing his Bloodstone Ring. When they got there and were spotted by young supervillains upon their entry into enemy territory. They were all shocked and surprised to find Cullen alive and well, partying in a bachelor pad owned by Arcade. Cammi was just as disoriented by his behavior as everyone else but chose to mingle at the party to take her mind off things alongside Hazmat and Aiden. She grew more and more distressed by how easily everyone else was taken in the the festivities when approached by senior members of the villain league, wanting to leave in that instant. She and the others were persuaded by Bloodstone to accompany him to murder their tormentor, Arcade, at a lavish new Murderworld galla. Initially Camille was livid at Cullen for wrapping them up in a hot mess where rich billionaires murdered each other at the behest of their insane benefactors' bloodsport, but was quickly dissuaded by Nico who retorted that they all needed closure in order to heal. After they were assailed by Arcade himself, who still had all of his powers from the previous Murderworld Arena he trapped them in; Death Locket managed to cut power and connectivity to his suit's systems. She and the rest of her compatriots proceeded to pummel him mercilessly, but was stunned and horrified when a previously-comatose Hazmat outright eviscerated him in cold blood right in front of them, to which she voiced concerns as to how their outright killing a man on a live, global television broadcast would most definitely land them all in jail or worse, right ar

camper van helsing.name: Camper van Helsing
camper van helsing.origin: Cami van Helsing was the last scion of the van Helsing family. Due to fear of her family's occupation, namely their eternal conflict against Dracula, Cami decided to stay away from monster-hunting, claiming to be disinterested rather than afraid. Thus, she instead followed a career as engineer, landing a job at Parker Industries' R&D division. Using Parker Industries' resources, Cami began working on a device named the Sandman in hopes to find a way to reverse the imminent curse of insomnia that befell any member of the Van Helsing family as soon as they reached 25 years of age. Unfortunately, Cami was fired before she could complete the Sandman for slacking off, as she preferred to spend time at home playing the Versus online game, leading her to accumulate roughly two absences a week over a period of three months. Cami was laid off at the same time Queen Shiklah launched an invasion on Manhattan from Monster Metropolis. Pretending to be trying to put an end to the invasion, Shiklah fooled Spider-Man into directing her to Parker Industries' laboratories, where Cami was packing her things. The Sandman caught Shiklah's attention, prompting her to take down Spider-Man and force Cami to modify it to extend its reach. Deadpool arrived at Parker Industries, having been tipped off by Blade about Cami's potential inherited mystic arsenal which could help with the invasion. Shiklah tried to use the Sandman in combination with the Scepter of the Manticore, but Cami's modifications had instead decreased its radius to zero, foiling Shiklah's plan to use the Sandman on the human inhabitants of Manhattan. Cami then escaped with Spider-Man and Deadpool to her apartment, where she started to look for a dowsing rod that could track specific monsters, in order to help Deadpool find Dracula. Together with Spider-Man and Deadpool, Cami flew over to Latvia to find Dracula, using the dowsing rod as a compass. Once they located the villain in the basement of a regular house, the heroes discovered that following his latest defeat at Logan's hands, Dracula had become a recluse devoted entirely to gaming, and had one of his slaves regularly lure people for him to drink their blood so he didn't even have to move from his den. No longer afraid of Dracula after witnessing his state, Cami confronted him. In the end, Cami and Dracula faced-off in a match of Versus to determine whether Dracula assisted them or Cami let him consume her. Cami won, and Dracula joined the heroes on their return to New York.

Using Parker Industries' resources, Cami began working on a device named the Sandman in hopes to find a way to reverse the imminent curse of insomnia that befell any member of the Van Helsing family as soon as they reached 25 years of age. Unfortunately, Cami was fired before she could complete the Sandman for slacking off, as she preferred to spend time at home playing the Versus online game, leading her to accumulate roughly two absences a week over a period of three months. Cami was laid off at the same time Queen Shiklah launched an invasion on Manhattan from Monster Metropolis. Pretending to be trying to put an end to the invasion, Shiklah fooled Spider-Man into directing her to Parker Industries' laboratories, where Cami was packing her things. The Sandman caught Shiklah's attention, prompting her to take down Spider-Man and force Cami to modify it to extend its reach. Deadpool arrived at Parker Industries, having been tipped off by Blade about Cami's potential inherited mystic arsenal which could help with the invasion. Shiklah tried to use the Sandman in combination with the Scepter of the Manticore, but Cami's modifications had instead decreased its radius to zero, foiling Shiklah's plan to use the Sandman on the human inhabitants of Manhattan. Cami then escaped with Spider-Man and Deadpool to her apartment, where she started to look for a dowsing rod that could track specific monsters, in order to help Deadpool find Dracula. Together with Spider-Man and Deadpool, Cami flew over to Latvia to find Dracula, using the dowsing rod as a compass. Once they located the villain in the basement of a regular house, the heroes discovered that following his latest defeat at Logan's hands, Dracula had become a recluse devoted entirely to gaming, and had one of his slaves regularly lure people for him to drink their blood so he didn't even have to move from his den. No longer afraid of Dracula after witnessing his state, Cami confronted him. In the end, Cami and Dracula faced-off in a match of Versus to determine whether Dracula assisted them or Cami let him consume her. Cami won, and Dracula joined the heroes on their return to New York.

camulus.name: Camulus
camulus.origin: ===Origins=== Camulus was a deity within the Celtic pantheon and a member of the Tuatha de Danaan. He was closely associated with the Gauntlets of Camulus, powerful artifacts capable of channeling and unleashing immense energy. ===Modern Age=== left|thumb|The Gauntlets of CamulusIn the modern era, Baron Mordo, a sorcerer known for his manipulative schemes, posed as the enigmatic "Accountant" and freed Casey Kinmont, an apprentice of Doctor Strange, from another dimension. Under Mordo's influence, Kinmont was transformed into a weapon, compelled to steal powerful magical artifacts from around the world. Among these artifacts were the Gauntlets of Camulus. Mordo observed that this marked the first time the Gauntlets had been activated on the Earth realm. Kinmont, under his control, wielded their power to unleash a devastating energy blast, striking Doctor Strange and causing significant destruction in the surrounding area. Despite the chaos, Doctor Strange, with the aid of his allies Kanna and Bats, managed to intervene. By sharing fragments of their own souls, they restored Kinmont's free will, breaking Mordo's hold over her.

cancer lmd.name: Cancer (LMD)
cancer lmd.origin: Cancer was one of the Life Model Decoys which Scorpio constructed to be a part of his new Zodiac. Scorpio was forced to activate his LMDs early due to an attack by the Defenders. During this fray, Cancer engaged in combat with the Hulk and was smashed to bits. Later, Scorpio created a new Cancer using the Zodiac Key. This Cancer joined the rest of the Zodiac and a mentally unstable Quicksilver in seeking revenge on the Avengers. Cancer, Gemini and Quicksilver attacked Avengers Mansion. Cancer ended up battling the Wasp who used her bio-sting on his water-vents, shorting him out. Scorpio created a third Cancer, again using the Zodiac Key. This Cancer joined the other LMDs in attacking the original Zodiac Cartel in Dallas, Texas. The LMDs succeeded in killing all of the original members, with the exception of Cornelius van Lunt and took their places in the criminal underworld. They next attacked a group of businessmen attending a cattle auction in Wichita, but were themselves attacked by the West Coast Avengers. Cancer fought the Moon Knight in this battle but fled when Sagittarius was destroyed by Hawkeye.

candace nelson.origin: Candace Nelson was Foggy Nelson's younger half-sister. She dated Matt Murdock for a short time. At some point, she moved to California. During this time she was caught for smuggling illegal immigrants into the United States. Later, when visiting her brother in New York, Candace found her friend Marissa Dwyer was missing. Charles Boroughs, who was posing as a police officer pretended to help Candace find her until he tried to kill her at a nightclub. Daredevil intervened, but police officers stopped Daredevil and allowed Boroughs to escape.

candace southern.name: Candace Southern
candace southern.origin: ===Early life=== Candace Southern was born into a wealthy family in Nassau County, the daughter of David and Linda Southern whose influence brought her into contact with figures such as family friend General Argyle Fist. Through their families, Candy grew up alongside Warren Worthington III and Cameron Hodge, with the three frequently spending time together as children. Candy and Warren's families moved in the same affluent social circles, and both inherited membership of the Hellfire Club through their parents. After completing finishing school, Candy persuaded her parents to allow her to move into an apartment in New York City. She found employment at the United Nations Headquarters while taking night classes at Archer College. ===X-Men=== thumb|left Candy was reunited with her childhood friend Warren at a nightclub, and the pair began dating. She later accompanied him to Bobby Drake's birthday party, unaware that Warren and his friends were the X-Men. While returning from a date, Candy and Warren learned that Warren's father had been murdered. The Dazzler subsequently abducted Candy and used her to force Angel's surrender. During her captivity, Candy discovered that Warren was Angel and that Dazzler was his uncle, who had murdered Warren's father to obtain the family fortune. Warren rescued her when Dazzler's base was destroyed, while Burtram apparently fell to his death. ===Searching for Warren=== right|150px After Bobby Drake unexpectedly left Zelda Kurtzberg's apartment, Zelda asked Candy to investigate the unusual activity surrounding Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. Candy visited the school looking for Warren, but was detained by a robotic sentry. She revealed to Professor Xavier that Warren had already told her about his identity as Angel and the X-Men. Convinced that her concern was genuine, Xavier granted Candy limited access to the school. Candy later returned with urgent news for Warren, only to learn that he was missing. She accompanied Cyclops and Marvel Girl in searching for him, wearing one of Jean's uniforms to conceal her identity. They found Warren and Avia aboard a vessel operated by Krueger, but Candy and the X-Men were captured and handed over to the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants. Despite having no powers, Candy helped fight their captors and knocked Krueger unconscious, contributing to the prisoners' escape. left|200px|thumb Candy then warned Warren that his supposedly deceased uncle, Burtram Worthington, the criminal known as the Dazzler, intended to marry his mother. She accompanied Warren and the X-Men to the Worthington estate, where they discovered that Burtram and Doctor Stuart were poisoning Kathryn Worthington to obtain the family fortune. Although the conspirators were defeated, Kathryn died from the poison, and Candy remained beside Warren as the authorities took them into custody. She later attended Hank McCoy's twentieth-birthday celebration. ===Life with Warren=== Candy remained involved in Warren's life and occasionally became caught up in his adventures. She was present when Master Mold abducted Warren and Iceman from Warren's Rocky Mountain home. Sometime after this, Candy and Warren attended a function at the Hellfire Club, having both inherited membership to the club but never attended before. They did not enjoy the experience, however, and soon left. As only casual members of the Hellfire Club, they were not aware of the Inner Circle's criminal machinations. They later used their membership to arrange invitations to a party at the club for the X-Men so they could infiltrate the club and attempt to rescue Jean Grey, who had been mentally controlled and abducted by them. She also accompanied Warren to the Zanadu Zone shortly before he and Thing were abducted by Toad. Candy was later abducted by Miss Locke and held with several of the X-Men's friends and relatives in Murderworld, until a reserve team rescued them. When Ghost Rider subsequently attacked Warren and left him comatose, Candy summoned the Avengers to investigate and remained beside Warren in hospital. ===Champions of Los Angeles=== After Warren's second superhero team, the Champions of Los Angeles, disbanded following financial problems, Candy and Warren began living together in his homes in New York, Colorado, and San Francisco. At Warren's New Mexico home, Candy welcomed Tanya Anderssen and listened as she explained how Karl Lykos had become Sauron and asked Warren to accompany her to the Savage Land. Candy later returned to their Manhattan penthouse and discovered blood and several of Warren's feathers, indicating that he had been abducted. She telephoned Professor Xavier for help, but was attacked by Sunder and thrown through a window. Nightcrawler caught Candy and carried her to Amanda Sefton's apartment, where she recovered while the X-Men searched for Warren. ===The New Defenders=== Candy accompanied Warren and Beast when Iceman informed his parents that he had resumed his superhero career. candice muggins.origin: Candi was one of Peter Parker's neighbors when he lived in Chelsea. She was the niece of the landlady Mrs. Muggins. She and her roommates Randi and Bambi often used to sunbathe on the building's roof, which made it difficult for Peter to surreptitiously get in and out of his skylight as Spider-Man, so he had to use various diversions to slip past them.

candra.name: Candra
candra.origin: ===Origin=== Candra, who has been referred to as The Benefactress and Candra of the Floating Spires, is part of a rare subspecies of immortal mutants called Externals, representing Guile in the Tapestry of the Infinite. Other than Candra’s claim that nearly a millennia ago a mortal gained possession of an External heart and it cost her dearly, dealings with the High Lords and her Heartgem, nothing is known of her past before her involvement with Assassins and Thieves Guild of New Orleans, as well the Egyptian Thieves Guild. ===High Lords=== During the twelfth century C.E., when some of her Externals formed the High Lords, Candra declined to join preferring not to share her power and play the "power broker" alone. Fearing the wrath of the others she formed a plan to extract the life energy of her own immortal heart into a stone. She summoned Selene, Saul, Crule, Nicodemus, and En Sabah Nur, her fellow Externals to aid her. While the ritual took place, Candra lay down on an alter with the stone in hand as the other stood around her. En Sabah Nur would take a blade of unknown energy, and sink it into her heart. As he did he felt that he could take her power for himself, and others (Selene) felt it was theft to keep a shared thing like that in a stone. Where Candra could hide it from them. But despite this non moved against her. The blade disappeared, and when En Sabah Nur place the now glowing stone on her chest, a serge of energy sparked around it and the ritual was done. With the ritual a success Candra now had the means to protect herself but at a cost; as with the gem, Candra has full access to her abilities. Without it, she is weakened and vulnerable. ===Absolute Psychic Zero=== Centuries ago, Candra was confronted by a time travelling Durisphinx. A machine built by Apocalypse in Ancient Egypt for the purpose of testing mutantkind. He tested her with the same riddle he tested Apocalypse, and like him, Candra failed to answer correctly. She fought Durisphinx, until he used his vast knowledge to find a weak point in any psychic attack. Using it, he was able to instantly propel her into a state of absolute psychic zero. Being left like that for three years, she was able to thaw and free her mind relatively quickly. ===The Guilds=== Generations ago, Candra arrived at the new world where she established a pact with the New Orleans Assassins and Thieves Guilds. She provided the Assassins with great power, enough to protect her should her immortal brethren intend to due her harm. She bestowed the thieves with Elixir of Life to extend their ability to divine and resurrect the Old Kingdom. These would be provided by monetary tribute from each guild every certain number of years through a ritual called “tithing". ===Tomorrow Starts Today=== thumb|left In 1891 London, the Thieves Guild's failure to acquire the Momentary Princess forced Jacques LeBeau and Rouler Marceaux to gather as much monetary tribute. Candra kidnapped their kids Jean-Luc LeBeau and Belize Marceaux. But the Tithe Collector, wanting to restore the way things were, helped Jacques bring her a text of gestation chamber En Sabah Nur. Thanks to Gambit from the future, alone with Courier came back to help his father and the guild be free of Candra made her aware of the man Dr. Nathan Milbury that knew of the location of the gestation chamber. As Candra went to America she sent the guild to find Nathan Milbury, while Gambit knowing Milbury was really Sinister tried to stop them. With his father Jean-Luc LeBeau, just a kid then and the rest of his guild captured by Sinister, long with his friend Courier he made a deal. If Sinister would free his clan and send them En Sabah Nur for Candra, as well as fix Courier and he’ll give him a piece of his brain in return. Once the guild made it beneath the pyramids outside of Banī-Mazā in Egypt, they were confronted by En Sabah Nur's servant Ozymandias. But unbeknownst to Guild LeBeau Candra had been following them. After she appeared she imprisoned Ozymandias with her telekinetic powers and waited for the guild who learned this place dates back to their earliest ancestry to translate the texts within the walls of En Sabah Nur ancient citadel which will give her powers to fold space through her magic as En Sabah Nur does through science. But before the guild could begin Gambit with The Courier and Sinister suddenly appeared using a transport ship Sinister got from En Sabah Nur years back, Gambit quickly attacks Candra catching her of guard. Candra enraged and deciding that she could take En Sabah Nur's power anytime begins to bring the sanctum down but she is stopped when attacked by Sinister who quickly overpowered her with his new found metamorphic ability. Defeated she begs for him to stop and as he does Sinister reveals the High Lords who knew of her plans come to stop her for all of them know En Sabah Nur's citadel is not to be touched, his glacier crawl to power is not to be interrupted. For their greater glor

candy fraser.name: Candy Fraser
candy fraser.origin: Candy was a mutant, but like most of the world's mutant population, she lost her powers on M-Day. Candy was best friends with another former mutant, Lenore Wilkinson. Sometime before her death, Candy confined to Lenore that she believed she was being followed. Lenore had similar suspicion about being followed. Candy's body was eventually found, and it appeared that she had committed suicide with a gunshot to the head. Lenore found this highly suspicious because Candy hated guns and even refused to watch movies with gunshots in them. Candy and Lenore were in fact being targeted for assassination by Cortex under the orders of Tryp and Anthony Falcone because their descendants would be mutants and become a part of the Summers Rebellion in the future.

cangza.name: Cangza
cangza.first_appearance: Rise of the Black Panther Vol 1 1
cangza.origin: Cangza was a member of the Taifa Ngao, the Wakandan tribal council. During a statecraft council with King T'Chaka, Cangza expressed his disapproval of previous King Azzuri having gifted a piece of Vibranium to Captain America during World War II. Cangza was also paranoid of the possible arrival of any visitors to Wakanda, and even doubted T'Chaka's own assurance that the Wakandan spy network hadn't found any evidence to suggest the American knew how to find their country.

Carnage was tied up along with the others after they surrendered with only Electro escaping.

caninus.name: Caninus
caninus.species: New Man evolved from a dog
caninus.origin: Caninus is an evolved dog created by the High Evolutionary as one of his New Men, animals given humanoid form and intelligence. When his master eventually learned that the god-like Celestials were coming to Earth to judge whether humanity should continue to exist or perish, he systematically began killing each of his creations, fearing that their unnatural presence may cause the Celestials to deem the planet unworthy. Both Caninus and Felinatus escaped genocide by hiding deep within their mountain home, where they later met and befriended the New Warriors.

cannibal.name: Cannibal
cannibal.origin: 205px|thumb|left|Host in prison ===Origin=== The Cannibal's origins are a mystery. He was a being able to transfer his essence from one body to another, and was described as a "psychic parasite". Somehow, he ended up in prison, in a secured area, after having committed some unrevealed crimes. thumb|left|Visited by Ulysses Klaw (Earth-616)|Klaw ===Meeting Klaw / Preparing Wakandan Invasion=== Ulysses Klaw came to prison, telling him stories of Wakanda, intending to recruit him and offering him a presidential pardon for his help in the invasion of Wakanda and the murder of the Black Panther. thumb|left|Cannibal and his future host Klaw then brought the Cannibal to a brothel and paid for an attractive blonde sex worker. The Cannibal kissed her, transferring his essence into her body, and leaving his former host dead. He reunited with Klaw, satisfied with his new body. thumb|left|150px|In Vatican City|Vatican "She" came to Klaw's camp in Niganda, meeting with Batroc, Radioactive Man, and Rhino. She was then sent to the Vatican, in order to seduce and recruit the Black Knight, and discussed the imminent crusade against Wakanda with a priest. ===Invasion of Wakanda=== While Klaw attacked Wakanda with all his forces, Cannibal was sent to New York City at the United Nations, in order to mess up the Wakandan diplomacy. She presented to T'Shan as Igor Stancheck/Radioactive Man's wife, and that he was a Chernobyl victim, mutated by the accident, that he was employed in exchange of a cure, and that she didn't trusted them. She offered her "help" in exchange of what Wakanda would cure her "husband". Although being checked by T'Shan's assistant regarding her profile, the presence of weapons, cybernetic enhancements, foreign biological agents, her marriage with Stancheck, no dissimulation was found. thumb|right|Transferring into T'Shan (Earth-616)|T'Shan Going to Wakanda in order to solve the situation, their plane was shot by Klaw, made miss his initial target by T'Challa. Close to death, the Cannibal managed to kiss T'Shan, transferring its consciousness into the Wakandan ambassador body, satisfied by the new body possessed and the possibilities offered by it.

cannon foot.name: Cannon Foot
cannon foot.origin: ===Origin=== The man who would come to be known as Cannon Foot was the son of Wolverine and a unnamed woman. Not much is known about the relationship apart from the fact that they had a child. Not much is known about Cannon Foot's past either except that one day he was found by his half-brother Daken in order to be used as a weapon against his own father. Daken then gave Cannon Foot to a powerful criminal organization called The Red Right Hand which had a personal vendetta against Wolverine. The leader of this criminal Organization then tasked one of its member to train Cannon Foot at becoming an efficient assassin, he then took the name of Cannon Foot due to his skill at kicking rocks like cannonballs. ===The Mongrels=== He later joined the team led by Gunhawk dubbed the "Mongrels". The team was created to eliminate, Wolverine's friends, family, and ex-girlfriends. Cannon Foot worked with Shadow S, Fire Knives, Saw Fist and Gunhawk who tracked down Wolverine's girlfriend at the time, Melita Garner. They found her working in the San Francisco Post building. When they found and attacked Melita, they were shocked to find her with a Skrull sonic disruptor, which she fired at the team. Melita escaped from the Mongrels with the help of the mutant shape shifter Mystique. The team returned to report their failure to the The Red Right Hand. They then decided to proceed to their next target in the nation of Madripoor. Cannon Foot and the team arrived in Madripoor and searched the city to find the Princess Bar. They entered a bar and massacred the bouncers and staff, but Tyger Tiger intervened when Gunhawk tried to open a certain door. Gunhawk told Tyger "Logan is in hell," and burned the room down, which was filled with mementos and possessions that Wolverine had accumulated over his long lifetime. Afterwards, Cannon Foot was the first of the Mongrels to face Wolverine, he was given a chance to surrender peacefully but he decided to fight him instead. The two battled, but Wolverine bested him in combat and killed him. It was after all the Mongrels died that Wolverine found out that Cannon Foot and the rest of the Mongrels were his children, which devastated him. Cannon Foot alongside the rest of the Mongrels was buried by Logan afterwards. It's unknown if Cannon Foot was aware that Daken was his half-brother and Logan his father, as the Red Right Hand and Daken only told him what was necessary to make him fight and die against his own father.

cannonball.name: Cannonball
cannonball.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 4: The New Mutants
cannonball.origin: ===Origins=== Samuel Zachery Guthrie was the eldest son of a large farming Kentucky family who was born on the 17th of October. Sam attempted to help out his family by working in a coal mine after his father had died there due to inhaling coal dust. Right on his first day, Sam and his father's friend, Lewis, were trapped in a cave-in. In his panic, Sam manifested his mutant blasting powers which allowed him and Lewis to escape the collapse. ===New Mutants=== This incident led to Sam being discovered by Donald Pierce, who recruited him in a plot to attack a young group of mutants Professor Charles Xavier, founder of the X-Men, had assembled. Sam eventually came to his senses and turned against Pierce. Professor Xavier saw the good inside Sam and invited him to join his New Mutants. Cannonball left his family to join the team. At Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, the New Mutants were tutored by Professor X and trained in the use of their powers in the Danger Room. Though the team was originally created because the Professor was possessed by the Brood Queen egg inside of him for future embryos, Cannonball remained with the team for its entire existence. He formed close friendships with his teammates, Wolfsbane and Sunspot, and a friendly rivalry with Danielle Moonstar (Psyche) who, along with Cannonball, was the team's co-leader. Cannonball saved the life of international rock star and mutant teleporter Lila Cheney. The two became romantically involved, but due to the nature of Lila's career, their relationship proceeded slowly. Later, during a trip to Asgard Sam ended-up in Nidavellir, where he befriended Eitri, King of the Dwarves. After their adventure in Asgard, the New Mutants found themselves under the guidance of a new teacher, Magneto. Sam briefly visited his hometown to introduce Lila to his family. His younger brother, Josh Guthrie (who didn't wish to become a mutant), enjoyed a ride on Sam's back and decided that being a mutant wouldn't be so bad if he would get to fly. When Illyana accidentally separated the New Mutants through time and space Cannonball, Cypher, Mirage, and Warlock were sent to a future where mutants ruled and their former teammates, Sunspot and Magma, were chief Arbitrators who oppressed humans and even kidnapped their mutant children. They were captured and about to be brainwashed until Illyana returned with Professor Xavier, Lilandra Neramani, and Binary. At a friendly soccer game Bobby da Costa accidentally ended-up giving Sam a concussion. Sunspot ran away, fearing he was a danger to his team. Warlock went after Sunspot and this left Sam and the team feeling deeply guilty and worried about Warlock and Sunspot's whereabouts. Following a previous battle with Mojo, the New Mutants ended up coming to the X-Men's aid when Mojo de-aged Magneto, Shadowcat, Colossus, Rogue, Wolverine, Storm, Nightcrawler, Psylocke, and Longshot into babies. In the battle that followed, the New Mutants were able to break the nine de-aged heroes free of Mojo's brainwashing. Not long after Cypher's death, Sam was among the New Mutants captured by a demon posing as Baba Yaga. Alongside Warlock, Dani, Roberto, and Rahne, Sam was fattened into obesity and would have been eaten had Illyana and Colossus not intervened. Sam was allowed to attend another of Lila's concerts, where she was attacked by the alien Intergalactic Red-Tape Brigade. The New Mutants arrived and, after Lila was captured, they met Gosamyr, who offered to help get Lila if the New Mutants helped her save her family. While tracking Lila in space, Gosamyr began to play on the emotions of Sam and Bobby, but Warlock and the women seemed to be immune to her powers. After arriving on the planet Lila was on, the New Mutants battled aliens and themselves, until Illyana attacked Gosamyr with her Soulsword and broke her hold on everyone. The New Mutants were captured by Spyder and Gosamyr's family was forcefully matured until Gosamyr rescued the New Mutants and Lila seemingly sacrificed herself to teleport Gosamyr's family into a sun. The mutants did not stay under the care of Magneto, as Cannonball and Mirage decided to move the team out from under Magneto's thumb. Magneto revealed that he joined the X-Men, led the New Mutants, and entered the Hellfire Club to build a foundation for control and peace among mutant kind. Magneto explained that the teams were to be his army against the coming war between humans and mutants. Magneto allowed the New Mutants to leave warning that, in time, they would find his ways right. The New Mutants were introduced to X-Factor and began to live on Ship, merging with the X-Terminators. One of the new members, Tabitha Smith, developed a crush on Sam. ===X-Force=== right|200px|thumb|As a member of X-Force Cannonball and the other New Mutants left the X-Men's supervision and joined forces with the mysterious war hawk Cable to become the hard-edged X-Force. canute.origin: In January of 1898, explorer Robert Walton IV mounted an expedition to the North Pole, Canute was the Inuit travel guide when Walton came upon the frozen remains of the Frankenstein Monster. Walton recognized the creature from stories passed down to him, and ordered it brought on board. Several superstitious crew members, attempted to destroy the monster but Canute stopped them and when he was then attacked by the crew Walton saved him. This crew then formed a mutiny. During the conflict, a fire broke out in one of the ship's lower cabins, and the intense heat thawed out the Frankenstein Monster. Revived, the creature lashed out and took a young cabin boy named Sean Farrell as hostage. To make matters even worse, Walton's ship struck an iceberg, killing several crewmen. The ship sunk and the monster attacked the lifeboat, sparing only Walton, Canute, and Sean so they can row to a safe shore together. canyon pete.name: Canyon Pete
canyon pete.origin: Canyon Pete was a outlaw that was active during the days of the American Frontier. He and his gang orchestrated a complicated plot to steal a shipment of gold bullion that was being run by rail from Grange City to nearby Tartleton some 40 miles away. To this end, Canyon Pete and his gang built another set of tracks which led the train away from Tartleton to Hidden Canyon where they took the engineers hostage and began unloading the train. However, their trip to Hidden Canyon took them across the property of the Bar T Ranch. The rancher's daughter Penelope Watson spotted Canyon Pete and his gang and rode into town to have the sheriff arrest them for trespassing. However, when she arrived in town she found the sheriff was too busy trying to solve the mystery of the missing train. She instead got the aid of the Two-Gun Kid who followed Canyon Pete's trail to Hidden Canyon. There, Canyon Pete got the drop on Two-Gun and Penelope while they were uncovering his train tracks. Before Pete could shoot them, Two-Gun's horse Cyclone kicked the guns out of Pete's hand. Two-Gun then shot Canyon Pete dead and held his gang at gunpoint until the sheriff and his posse could come and arrest them.

cape crow.name: Cape Crow
cape crow.origin: Cape Crow was an assassin with a legendary reputation who decided to retire in order to have a family. Not content to let him leave the game, the Assassins Guild put out a hit on him. This forced Cape Crow and his family to spend their days in hiding. Cape Crow was tracked down by Scalphunter, Bullseye, Taskmaster, and Sabretooth at his safehouse at the Arctic Circle. Crow was able to defeat the assassins but went further into hiding, leaving his son behind. His son, desperate to find his father, recruited Elektra to help him find Cape Crow. The three of them then tracked down the leader of the Assassins Guild in order to free Cape Crow from the target on his back.

capitaine fantome.name: Capitaine Fantome
capitaine fantome.origin: Capitaine Fantome was a member of France's superhero black ops team known as the Le Bureau Discret who found their teammate Anaïs "dead" in the Montmartre hilltop-borough of northern Paris. Trying to determine the cause of death they brought in their specialist, Le Necrogateur to telepathically read her last memories. But Fantome and her group were ambushed by X-Force before learning Anaïs was only hit with a suspended animation bullet that simulated death. The main target was Necrogateur himself, and X-Force body-slided out of there while leaving the team and Fantome out cold.

capo.name: Capo
capo.species: Inhuman powered by Terrigenesis migrating from body to body
capo.origin: The Capo was an Inhuman who lived only as an astral entity, possessing bodies as a parasite to sustain his life. He'd been the head of the Ennilux Corporation for centuries, if not millennia. Every generation, within the Ennilux's ranks, the creation of a body fitting as the "Capo" host was genetically engineered, but the last ones were too weak, flawed. This led, for the first time in the history of the organization, to the decision to pass on the "Capo" conscience in the body of a NuHuman that seemed to have the constitution and the genetic sequences required for the transfer.

caprice hastings.name: Caprice Hastings
caprice hastings.first_appearance: Darkhold: Pages from the Book of Sins Vol 1 8
caprice hastings.origin: Caprice was the daughter and only child of Louise Hastings, an occult expert who was also a professor of archeology at Oxford University. Nothing has been revealed about Caprice's childhood except that she and her mother lived under the same roof for 18 years, during which time they lost touch with each other and became estranged. Less than three years after she stopped living with her mother, Caprice became pregnant with her only child, a son she named William who she apparently raised as a single mother. At some point, Caprice and Will began living in a house in Los Angeles. Although Caprice and her mother remained estranged, Caprice did not prevent Will, nicknamed "Jinx," from developing close ties with his grandmother. When Caprice was 35 years old and working as a flight attendant for an unspecified airline, she unexpectedly encountered her mother while on a flight from Maui to Los Angeles. Although Louise was happy to see her, Caprice gave her the cold shoulder. Later, after a spell from a Darkhold Page was cast aboard the plane during its descent towards Los Angeles, Caprice found her fellow flight attendant, Frank, who was unaware that his face had been torn off by the Wish-Demon summoned by the spell. Only seconds later, when her mother's friend Dr. Victoria Montesi was distracted by trying to treat Frank, a passenger wearing a Hawaiian shirt pulled a gun and tried to kill Montesi but she survived by using the indestructible Darkhold page as a shield. An attempt by Interpol agent Sam Buchanan to disarm the gunman briefly kept him from firing any more shots, but then he broke free and was immediately confronted by an airline security agent who held a gun on him. However, instead of surrendering, the gunman fired two shots, killing the agent and fatally wounding Caprice, before Buchanan spoke a wish that caused the Wish-Demon to hurl the gunman from the plane to his death. Aware that she was probably going to die, Caprice spoke with her mother, telling her that Will was going through a tough time and would need his grandmother if she died. When she asked her mother to promise to take care of Will, Louise assured her that she would, calling Caprice "Baby" as she did so. This reminded Caprice that she hadn't heard her mother call her that for a long time, since Louise had been with Archie (her fifth husband). Fading fast, Caprice used her last words to tell her mother a secret, that she had "always been so proud of the mighty Professor Hastings," and Louise told her daughter that she had always loved her. Buchanan managed to voice a specific wish that undid the Wish-Demon and then safely landed the jumbo jet at the airport, but by then Caprice had died in her mother's arms. A few days later, Caprice was buried in a cemetery in Los Angeles. One of Louise's friends, Father Vittorio Montesi, flew in from Rome to conduct the service. That night, after the funeral, Louise used the Wishing Page to summon the Other, but only so she could defiantly state that she would never use the page to wish Caprice back to life. Jinx, who had been secretly watching, waited until his grandmother had left the room and then tried to use the Wishing Page, but he got the words wrong and ended up unconscious while the innate magical potential that he didn't even know he possessed bound the demon for a time.

fields.notes: The fact Caprice was 35 years old when she died while Jinx was a 14-year-old means that Caprice must have been either 20 or 21 years old when she gave birth to her son. In all their appearances, Caprice and her son William/Jinx were only addressed by their first names/nicknames and never by their surnames. According to the profile on Jinx that was published in , Caprice's original surname was "Hastings" and that statement implies that she had changed it, presumably after marrying her son's father whose name has never been revealed. That profile also suggests that Will's father had died or abandoned the family when Will was still quite young and that that was why he used the "Hastings" surname. However, there has never been any in-story evidence that either Caprice or Will ever actually used the "Hastings" surname. Although two online profiles claim that Caprice's father was Louise's third husband and that Louise was married at least eight times, neither profile cites any sources for this data. In the absence of any in-story evidence, the only thing that is known about Caprice's father is that he was not Archie, her mother's fifth husband. Many details about Caprice's life remain unknown. Based on the fact that she lived for 18 years under the same roof with her mother who is known to have spent most of her life in England, they presumably lived somewhere in that country and Caprice may (or may not) have also been born there. Her father's identity has never been revealed and it is not known if her parents were ever married. Similarly, the identity of Will's father has never been revealed, it has never been established that Caprice was ever married to Will's father, the country where Caprice gave birth to Will has never been identified, and the reason why Will's father was apparently never part of his son's life has never been mentioned in-story. The fact that Caprice was living in Los Angeles with her son at the time of her death has been taken to mean that she was an American citizen, but she could have had dual British/American citizenship if she was born in England and her father was American. Alternatively, Caprice may have actually been born in the United States or she may have been a British citizen who emigrated to the United States and became a naturalized US citizen.

capricorn lmd.name: Capricorn (LMD)
capricorn lmd.origin: thumb|left|The original Capricorn and Pisces died shortly after being activated Capricorn was one of the Life Model Decoy created by Scorpio to serve as part of his new Zodiac. Scorpio was forced to awaken the LMDs of his new group early as he was surprised by an attack by the Defenders at his New Jersey headquarters. Unfortunately, Capricorn, as well as Pisces and Virgo, were activated too soon and he died shortly thereafter. Scorpio found both Capricorn and Pisces dead in the hallway, having barely been awake before they deactivated. Later, Scorpio created another Capricorn using the Zodiac Key. This Capricorn joined the rest of the Zodiac in aiding a mentally unstable Quicksilver, who was seeking revenge on the Avengers. Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces and Sagittarius all went to the "anthill," an abandoned Sentinel base. Here Capricorn fought against the Black Widow and the Black Panther. He attempted to take the battle to higher ground, but was taken down by the Avengers and was later turned into the authorities. Scorpio next transformed Capricorn into a female using the Zodiac Key. This new female incarnation of Capricorn joined the rest of the Zodiac in travelling to Dallas, Texas, where they confronted and killed all of the members of the original Zodiac Cartel, with the exception of Cornelius van Lunt and took their places in the criminal underworld. Next, the Zodiac attacked a group of businessmen attending a cattle auction in Wichita, where they were opposed by the West Coast Avengers. Capricorn fought against Iron Man, but fled when Sagittarius was destroyed by Hawkeye.

Unfortunately, Capricorn, as well as Pisces and Virgo, were activated too soon and he died shortly thereafter. Scorpio found both Capricorn and Pisces dead in the hallway, having barely been awake before they deactivated. Later, Scorpio created another Capricorn using the Zodiac Key. This Capricorn joined the rest of the Zodiac in aiding a mentally unstable Quicksilver, who was seeking revenge on the Avengers. Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces and Sagittarius all went to the "anthill," an abandoned Sentinel base. Here Capricorn fought against the Black Widow and the Black Panther. He attempted to take the battle to higher ground, but was taken down by the Avengers and was later turned into the authorities. Scorpio next transformed Capricorn into a female using the Zodiac Key. This new female incarnation of Capricorn joined the rest of the Zodiac in travelling to Dallas, Texas, where they confronted and killed all of the members of the original Zodiac Cartel, with the exception of Cornelius van Lunt and took their places in the criminal underworld. Next, the Zodiac attacked a group of businessmen attending a cattle auction in Wichita, where they were opposed by the West Coast Avengers. Capricorn fought against Iron Man, but fled when Sagittarius was destroyed by Hawkeye.

captain achhimmel.name: Captain Achhimmel
captain achhimmel.origin: Captain Achhimmel was the special detail chief of the Gestapo in Nazi Germany during World War II. By the summer of 1942, he was primarily in charge of executing those who spoke against the state, notably famous artists and writers. Like many before him, his operations were targeted by the Destroyer, earning the Nazi's ire. He and his colleague Inga von Leche began working together in the hopes of destroying the hero once and for all. They would become dupes to the Destroyer's brand of vigilante justice, when the hero posed as German writer Louis Kramer and earned their trust. They agreed to "Kramer's" plot to have someone pose as the Destroyer and pretend to rescue three outspoken German writers in order to lure the real Destroyer into a trap and capture him. Ironically, Achhimmell and Leeche chose "Kramer" to play the role. The fake break out was pulled off, and the German writers were recaptured. However, when the "real" Destroyer came to re-rescue their captives, he succeeded. During the clash, Inga accidentally shot Achhimmel, killing him. Although she would tell "Kramer" later that the Destroyer had killed her superior officer -- she apparently was happier having slain Achhimmel and taken his place than she was capturing the Destroyer.

captain amerigo.name: Captain Amerigo
captain amerigo.origin: According to the claims of 1940s criminal Dr. Emil Natas, Sir Amerigo is a past-life incarnation of Captain America who was active during the Middle Ages. He was also a reincarnation of an ancient hero called Hercules. Amerigo was probably born in the 13th century and was an adult during his only recorded appearance, in AD 1313. He was reportedly a "noble knight". He took a young boy called Bucky as his squire. The boy was supposedly a past incarnation of James Buchanan Barnes. In 1313 AD, Amerigo and his squire Bucky were traveling on horseback. They entered a small town at night time, seeking a room for the night and a meal. Amerigo soon realized that he could not wake the townspeople and found it strange. Bucky initially suspected that the people were simply drunk. Discovering Diablo Natas counting his stolen gold, Amerigo drew his sword and attacked the apparent thief. Natas was able to use a spell to paralyze Amerigo. Studying his foe, Natas realized that he was the reincarnation of his old foe Hercules. He quickly explained their shared history to the helpless Amerigo. He took over Amerigo's sword and prepared to pierce the man's throat with it. He claimed that once Amerigo died, their paths would never cross again in future ages. He was soon attacked by Bucky, who was eager to save his employer. Natas and Bucky faced each other in combat. Natas was armed with the sword, while Bucky relied on his bare fists. Bucky turned out to be a more skilled fighter. He disarmed Natas and beat him up. A battered and bruised Natas was forced to release the knight, in order to escape a further beating by the enraged Bucky. Once Bucky let go of him, Natas tried to cast another spell. A punch from Amerigo took him down again. An enraged Amerigo forced Natas to reverse his spell on the town, even though Natas claimed that the price for the counter-spell would be the sorcerer's own life. With the counter-spell performed, the people awoke while Natas was suddenly on death's door. He had reportedly sold his soul for the original spell and undoing it cost him dearly. With his dying words, Natas once more sword vengeance against the two heroes in a future incarnation. He predicted that the next incarnation of Hercules would be called Captain America. Amerigo was left wondering if this "evil soul" could be reborn. Bucky shuddered at the thought. Amerigo went on to have unrecorded adventures. He eventually died, and was reincarnated in the 20th century as Steven Rogers.

fields.notes: The claims of Emil Natas are unsubstantiated. The story featuring the villain left it uncertain if his claims of past lives were true or not. It ends with many open questions. Natas' tales are questionable at best and Bucky suspected that Natas was insane. The story does not actually give an origin for Amerigo. He is described as a "noble knight" and that is about it. No nationality, affiliation, or previous combat experience is mentioned for him. While carrying a sword and shield, Amerigo was never actually depicted using them. In the section of the story which takes part in the Middle Ages, most of the fighting is performed by Bucky the squire. The knight only throws a single punch. There is an inconsistency concerning Amerigo's shield. When entering the enchanted town, Amerigo is carrying a shield. He still has it on another panel, while exploring the streets of the city. When going indoors and facing Diablo Natas, Amerigo no longer carries a shield. The shield is never seen or mentioned for the rest of the story.
fields.trivia: "Amerigo" is an Italian name. It is an Italian form of the Old High German name "Haimirich" ("ruler of the home"). The best known user of the name was explorer and cartographer Amerigo Vespucci (1454-1512). The Latin form of his name was "Americus Vespucius", and the "new" continent America was named after him.

captain barracuda.name: Captain Barracuda
captain barracuda.origin: Captain Barracuda was a modern-day pirate who tried to board a city cruise ship, which happened to hold Iceman, the Human Torch, and Dorrie Evans as its passengers. He was defeated by the two heroes and arrested after he crashed his ship into an iceberg created by Iceman. thumb|left|150px Barracuda reappeared later, capturing Namor the Submariner and Karthon the Quester who were fighting for the Serpent Crown. Barracuda took the crown for himself, but was again defeated when he stole a sonic device that attracted a torpedo into his own ship. He survived and has since clashed with both the Fantastic Four (when he stole the horn which the Sub-Mariner used to control sea monsters and used it to attack New York) and the Hulk. During one of his later appearances, he was defeated this time by Hawkeye and Deadpool. Captain Barracuda eventually replaced his crew with Robo-Buccaneers of his own creation. During a confrontation with Stingray, who had uncovered Barracuda's caviar smuggling ring, Barracuda's ship was approached by a submarine piloted by Machinesmith, a member of the rising A.I. Army. Using an Un-Inhibitor, Machinesmith freed the Robo-Buccaneers from Barracuda's control. They all defected, leaving an astonished Barracuda to fight Stingray on his own.

Barracuda took the crown for himself, but was again defeated when he stole a sonic device that attracted a torpedo into his own ship. He survived and has since clashed with both the Fantastic Four (when he stole the horn which the Sub-Mariner used to control sea monsters and used it to attack New York) and the Hulk. During one of his later appearances, he was defeated this time by Hawkeye and Deadpool. Captain Barracuda eventually replaced his crew with Robo-Buccaneers of his own creation. During a confrontation with Stingray, who had uncovered Barracuda's caviar smuggling ring, Barracuda's ship was approached by a submarine piloted by Machinesmith, a member of the rising A.I. Army. Using an Un-Inhibitor, Machinesmith freed the Robo-Buccaneers from Barracuda's control. They all defected, leaving an astonished Barracuda to fight Stingray on his own.
abilities: He is a skilled leader, a proficient thief and talented in both conventional and advanced firearms. He is also an expert seaman and commandeered two submarines armed with many high-tech weapons.
weaknesses: Since he can only see with one eye, his depth perception is greatly hindered.

captain benson.name: Captain Benson
captain benson.origin: A captain with the NYPD in 1940, Captain Benson enlisted the aid of renowned physician Jack Castle in a series of kidnappings after one missing man appeared at Benson's precinct, now a mindless zombie. This led to Castle gaining super-powers that allowed him to defeat the zombies' creator and rescue their latest would-be victim. After relating his story to Benson, Castle explained his intention to use his powers to do good, wearing a mask to cover his face after Benson noted that his face would glow when he was excited or angry. Captain Benson's further associations with Jack Castle, a.k.a. the Fiery Mask, are unknown.

fields.notes: In modern times, the Fiery Mask admitted that he'd been granted his powers from a dying accident victim, and he had made up the false origin of the Zombie Master to assuage his guilt. Whether or not Captain Benson was therefore an actual police official that Castle knew of is unclear.
fields.trivia: Captain Benson may or may not have been the same police official who enlisted Dr. Castle in another series of kidnappings which resulted in a brief plague of "vampire-men". This police captain was never named but knew that Dr. Castle was the Fiery Mask, so he may have been a trusted colleague that Captain Benson shared Castle's secret with, or may have been Benson rendered differently by the artist.

captain brool.name: Captain Brool
captain brool.origin: Captain Brool was a member of the Nazis during World War II. By the spring of 1943, he was in charge of a Gestapo base in Nazi occupied France. Charged with stamping out the Free French resistance movement, he captured two French freedom fighters named Lamonte and Farrotte. Hoping to get information out of them about the resistance before executing them, Captain Brool was denied this privilege when the two men apparently died in their cells under mysterious circumstances. In reality, the Destroyer had smuggled in a drug that simulated death for a few hours in order to smuggle the men out of captivity. Brool stumbled upon this plot but was beaten into submission by the Destroyer and handed over to the Free French resistance to be questioned. His subsequent fate is unknown.

captain confusion.name: Captain Confusion
captain confusion.origin: Captain Confusion was a small-time criminal once taken down and branded by Moon Knight. He was a prisoner at The Myrmidon, and he bullied 8-Ball until he was scared away by Moon Knight, who had been imprisoned following Mayor Wilson Fisk's crackdown on vigilantes. When he set out to infiltrate The Myrmidon's underground fighting ring, Moon Knight provoked Captain Confusion, so he and his clique bribed a guard to stage an ambush. Moon Knight was taken to the showers, where Captain Confusion and four other inmates confronted him, but they were all soundly defeated.

captain cookie.name: Captain Cookie
captain cookie.species: Possibly the product of Jimmy Jupiter's imagination
captain cookie.origin: Captain Cookie is a member of the Candy Men race that live in the possibly imaginary world of Nowhere that was frequently visited by young Jimmy Jupiter during the 1940's. After rescuing the Candy Men from the Gloomy Gusses, Captain Cookie offered to take Jimmy on a voyage to other lands in the realm of Nowhere. It was an offer the lad could not resist. Their voyage took them to the Land of Tea, home of the China People, living creatures fashioned after fine china. There they were not welcomed until Jimmy saved a young girl from the Bull in a China Shop. Welcomed as friends Captain Cookie and Jimmy were invited to a banquet where Jimmy was given a pet Likker Snik, an animal that ate only licorice, whom he named Fido. Returning to sea, Captain Cookie, Jimmy and his crew got lost in a massive storm and were running low on supplies when they came across an uncharted island. Exploring the island they were attacked by the deadly and savage Licorice Men, who captured Cookie and his crew to eat them. Jimmy would save Captain Cookie and his crew using Fido to consume the Licorice Men. Stocked up, they returned to the land of the Candy Men. Jimmy decided it was time to return home and he thanks Captain Cookie for the adventure before departing.

captain cybor.name: Captain Cybor
captain cybor.species: Alien Cyborg fully turned into a Robot
captain cybor.origin: Cybor was a robot that had been attached to the mast of a spaceship. He acted as the captain, while Xeron the Starslayer was his first mate. They acted as space pirates and bounty hunters. Cybor was obsessed with capturing Klaatu, who escaped to earth and led to a direct confrontation with The Hulk. However, Hulk proved too much for them, and they fled from Earth. Years later, Hulk had gotten lost in space, which led to Cybor and his crew capturing him. Hulk's ally Puffball then rescued him, and destroyed the ship, killing most of its crew and Cybor. Xeron was wounded but survived, but preferred to die with the rest of his crew, which were then buried in the sand by Klaatu to give them some sort of burial even though they had hunted him for years.

captain daring.name: Captain Daring
captain daring.origin: Lee Bradford was captain of the Sky-Sharks, a group of fighter pilots that fought for the Allies during World War II. His reputation had earned him the nickname "Captain Daring". By the winter of 1943, he had learned that Lieutenant Raeger was working for the Nazis and was responsible for the capture of Colonel Welling by the Nazis. When he attempted to apprehend Raeger in a Southhampton tea shop, he was ironically stopped by the colonel's daughter Valerie, who mistook Daring's exploits as empty bragging rather than heroic exploits. However, after Raeger escaped, she soon learned her mistake. Despite the misunderstanding, Daring vowed to rescue her father. To this end, Daring and his fellow Sky-Shark Zeke Mallon participated in a prisoner exchange in Berlin, going there to exchange the Nazi agent Marshall von Hapz for Colonel Welling. However, this turned out to be nothing more than a double cross, and both Daring and Zeke were captured and locked up with Welling. To their surprise, they were assisted in escaping by Raeger, whom they learned was really a double agent working for the allies. During their escape, Raeger was fatally shot, and Daring promised to tell of his bravery upon his return to England. Escaping to the airfield where their plane was kept, Daring and the others were held back by Nazi forces until a surprise attack by the other Sky-Sharks cleared the path. Daring returned to Southampton along with Zeke and Welling and with Von Hapz once more their prisoner. Upon his return to Southampton, Daring was thanked by Valerie for saving her father with a kiss. thumb|right ===Valhalla Villas=== Lee Bradford later appeared as a resident of Valhalla Villas, a retirement home for ex-heroes and ex-villains located in Miami. He was among the residents that were temporarily de-aged by Mary Morgan, who used an unnamed Asgardian artifact during a world-ending event known as an incursion.

captain forsa.name: Captain Forsa
captain forsa.origin: Captain Forsa was a hero operating in Brazil. In a news conference, Forsa pronounced that he would find and punish whomsoever was killing the heroes of South America. A female reporter questioned how he could stop the "hero killer" without knowing why the killer was targeting heroes. Forsa stated he was confident he could discover and stop the killer. Later, at his hotel room, Forsa found the female reporter waiting for him. Appreciative of her advances, he declined, stating that he was happily married. The reporter handed him photographs of him lying dead on the floor of his hotel room. Forsa demanded to know where the pictures came from. The reporter revealed himself to be Zeitgeist. Captain Forsa attacked him but Zeitgeist disappeared. After a moment, Zeitgeist re-appeared and skewered Forsa with his sword. As Forsa lay dying on the floor, Zeitgeist used an instant camera to take a picture of him. The murder of Captain Forsa was later investigated by the Schutz Heiligruppe.

captain kane.name: Captain Kane
captain kane.origin: Captain Kane was hired by Professor Briggs to help find Doctor Parker who went missing ten years ago. After reaching latitude X, Captain Kane's boat was sunk by what he thought was an island. After him and Professor Briggs washed up on the island they were captured by the natives and taken to the same place as Doctor Parker who they had also tied up. After explaining his research with Growth Hormones, the giant snapping turtle known as Experiment 247 appeared out of the jungle and Captain Kane fantastised about what would happen if the creature was brought to the city. After escaping the island, they discovered the Doctor's first experiment, Experiment XYZ was an even larger turtle and was the "island" that sunk Captain Kane's boat.

captain koenig.name: Captain Koenig
captain koenig.origin: S.H.I.E.L.D. Captain Koenig was mandated by S.W.O.R.D. to arrest another Skrull refugee group hiding in Palermo, Italy, along with two other agents and a containment unit. Just before the strike, he was stopped by Director Brand to stand, waiting for his team to be enforced by Captain America and Hawkeye, while Hyperion and Thor were ready to back them up. Using a device who scrambled the aliens shape-shifting powers, they easily defeated and arrested them, all of them being civilian refugees who vainly tried to escape.
