carol landers.name: Carol Landers
carol landers.origin: Carol Landers was a childhood friend of Susan Richards, aka the Invisible Girl of the Fantastic Four. As an adult she married rancher Bob Landers and the couple settled on a horse ranch in Pennsylvania. When Sue was going through marital problems with her husband Reed Richards, she separated from him. Susan and her son Franklin were welcomed to the Landers ranch. However the constant dangers that faced the Fantastic Four soon encroached on their peaceful home. Not long after Susan arrived, she was kidnapped by the Dragon Man. Sue was soon rescued by the Fantastic Four and returned to the Landers ranch shortly thereafter. Later, the couple had to deal with Franklin's strange behavior, such as when he began screaming suddenly. When Franklin's condition became more serious, both Carol and Bob suggested that Sue return home. They soon learned that Sue never made it back to the Baxter Building, but was captured somewhere along the way. Sue was once again rescued by the Fantastic Four, but did not return with them as Reed shut down Franklin's mind in order to keep his explosive mutant powers in check. Horrified by what her husband had done, Sue fled back to the Landers ranch. When Sue returned to Carol and Bob's home, she tearfully explained everything to them. While Sue stood by her son's comatose body day and night, Carol and Bob pressed Sue with the fact that she could not hide in Pennsylvania forever. Not long after this, Sue decided that she was going to divorce her husband. Both Carol and Bob were against the idea, but soon the Sub-Mariner came to their property and kidnapped Sue. Later when the Thing and Human Torch arrived searching for Sue, they told them what had happened. Shortly thereafter, it was revealed that the Sub-Mariner acted out in order to convince Reed and Sue to reconcile their marriage and divorce proceedings were cancelled. Sue then returned to the Baxter Building with her son. Sometime later, Bob and Carol were invited to a Christmas party being held at the Baxter Building where they mingled with other guests. The Landers have not interacted with Sue or the Fantastic Four since, suggesting that either the drifted apart or the couple have willingly stayed away from the Fantastic Four due to the chaos the team brought to their lives.

carol lindenbrook.name: Carol Lindenbrook
carol lindenbrook.origin: left|thumb|150pxDaniel Lindenbrook and his wife, Carol, were two Russian sleeper agents whose DNA had been altered by Dr. Constantin Racal's biogenetic program. When Racal visited the Lindenbrooks' home years after they had settled in the United States and started a family, including a son named Philip, he recited a nursery rhyme. The couple awoke and transformed into monstrous beings ready to do Racal's bidding.

carol peterson.name: Carol Peterson
carol peterson.origin: Carol Peterson was a part of the Humanity's Last Stand anti-mutant organization. She was chosen for the Mutant Liberation Front, a group of Last Standers using drugs, cybernetics, and other means to achieve superhuman powers, then commit acts of terrorism that would be blamed on mutants. When the Punisher, X-Cutioner, and S.H.I.E.L.D. attacked the Last Stand bunker in East Buffolk, Oklahoma, their leader Simon Trask decided to blow the entire base to eliminate his enemies. Thermal was the only known survivor of the MLF in the aftermath.

carol rayne.name: Carol Rayne
carol rayne.origin: While camping with her husband, Dexter, the two discovered a small statue buried in the ground. The couple discussed the possible origin of the statue, observing that it didn't look like it would be made by any local First Nations' groups, humorously speculating it came from a UFO or Atlantis. The next morning Dexter's behaved oddly which scared Carol. Unbeknownst to her, Dexter had fallen under the command of Llan, the Sorcerer. As she prepared breakfast, Dexter approached her from behind and choked her to death. He then performed a ritual sacrifice and his body was replaced by that of Llan's.

carol rhodes.name: Carol Rhodes
carol rhodes.origin: Carol is the daughter of James Rhodes, who was among the heroes who survived the cataclysm that scorched the Earth and went underground to escape the lethal radiation. Named after Carol Danvers, she was born and spent her entire life in an underground facility located under New York City. Following Captain Marvel's sacrifice to restart the Sun, the survivors had started regaining the surface. They also learned of the existence of other groups of survivors, namely one led by Ove. After Carol's group came across a time-displaced younger Captain Marvel, plucked from the timeline of Earth-616 due to the machinations of Ove and the Enchantress, he sent a mind-controlled Luke Cage to deliver an invite to his haven, New Atlantis. Carol joined the group that accompanied Captain Marvel to New Atlantis, but was tasked with remaining invisible. The heroes were initially welcomed with hospitality, but Captain Marvel and her group, save for Carol, were ultimately captured since Ove intended to sacrifice Captain Marvel for a time-travelling spell to go to the past himself. Carol then used her invisibility and intangibility to free her friends, but the strain knocked her out before liberating everybody. Once she recovered, everybody joined the fight against Ove and the Enchantress. In the aftermath of the Enchantress' sacrifice to send Ove herself to the past, the survivors from Carol's group moved to New Atlantis and Captain Marvel was returned to her time. Carol's existence in this dystopian timeline would have a lasting impact in Captain Marvel. With the knowledge that Jim Rhodes would have a daughter without her, Captain Marvel decided to break up with the Jim Rhodes of her time, out of fear that being with him meant she was preventing Carol's possible existence.

carol ridgely.name: Carol Ridgely
carol ridgely.origin: Carol Ridgely was a woman who lived in Harlem. Married to Owen Ridgely, she had at least one daughter. Her husband Owen had recently served as a soldier to Gideon Mace and wanted to go up against him, only to be killed by Mace's soldiers when he attempted to contact Luke Cage.

carol selby.name: Carol Selby
carol selby.origin: Carol Selby was the daughter of Olivia Selby and a student at Citrusville High. When her mother became concerned about the subjects being taught to her daughter in high school, she formed a group called the Mothers of Decency, a group which led a mob (co-formed by the Mad Viking) to Citrusville High to burn the offending textbooks. After witnessing the mob's carnage, which saw the books burned, a teacher crippled and the Mad Viking killing his own granddaughter, Carol decided to tag along with Richard Rory and the Man-Thing when they decided to leave Citrusville. Later she told Richard that she had lied about her age and that she was really under 17, which made Rory guilty of statutory kidnapping. After an experience where they were attacked by the Scavenger (who was stopped by the Man-Thing), Richard, Carol, and Man-Thing decided to leave the area after they were kicked out of the motel they were staying in. They were soon involved in a head-on collision with a car driven by a demon of Thog (who was trying to deliver a nightmare box, and couldn't read English road signs.) Deciding to stay at the wreck, Richard faced the music and was arrested for "kidnapping" Carol, and Carol was returned home to Citrusville. Her current activities are unknown, and even though Richard did briefly return to Citrusville the two have yet to reunite.

carolina pissarro.name: Carolina Pissarro
carolina pissarro.origin: Carolina was an artist who was being blackmailed by the Owl and Diamondhead. One day, on her way to make a payment to them, she met the Vision and the Black Widow at a restaurant and asked for their help, which they readily accepted and soon, along with the other Avengers, and specifically Nova, captured the two blackmailers. She and the Vision began dating and she helped the Vision and Nova search the Avengers' room's when they were trying to discover who the imposter among them was.

carolina washington.name: Carolina Washington
carolina washington.origin: Present at the clean-ups of various super-hero battles, including the death of Goliath, the seeming-death of Captain America, and the Skrull invasion, Carolina Washington began to firmly believe someone needed to police and control the super-powered community. Beginning with Goliath's corpse, Washington began collecting the genetic material of various beings, stockpiling them for future use. Following the rise of Steve Rogers as the government-appointed head of the super-human community and Norman Osborn's escape from federal custody, she sought Osborn out, finding him with a reorganized H.A.M.M.E.R.. When asked what value she could bring to the organization, she revealed her stock of empowered subject genetic samples, and was welcomed aboard by Osborn and his fellow HAMMER agents. With the promulgation of Kamala's Law, the law that banned under-ages from being super-heroes, she became a member of C.R.A.D.L.E., the supervisory body responsible for compliance with this law. After the chaos created during the march in Chicago organized by the boys against Kamala's Law who clashed with the boys who supported the law, Washington intervened by telling police that the confrontation had become the jurisdiction of C.R.A.D.L.E. as they incited vigilant violence.

carolyn lepre.name: Carolyn Lepre
carolyn lepre.origin: Doctor Carolyn Lepre was a psychiatrist who was assigned to work with super-powered criminals, in which her purpose was to rehabilitate or reform them if possible. Even while her task was proven to be difficult, she started to work with Brock Rumlow for six months when they retuirned to the Colorado Memorial Hospital for another session. She was surprised by the presents that was given to her from the police, but would learn from Doctor Hardy about a dangerous situation inside the hospital. She decided to get near the terrorists since she planned on wanting to talk them out of this situation and planned to meet them posing as the top neuro-surgeon Doctor Wilson. She locked Crossbones away in a heavily guarded room and proceeded to meet the Fortress. She was suddenly rescued by Crossbones, who had arrived to take them down.

carolyn schist.name: Carolyn Schist
carolyn schist.origin: Carolyn Schist was the daughter of Vivian Schist and the late F.A. Schist. Following her father’s disappearance in the Florida Everglades, Carolyn accompanied her mother to investigate the abandoned construction site linked to his fate. During the trip, she encountered the Man-Thing when the creature attacked the party, though unlike her mother, Carolyn eventually came to doubt that the swamp-being was truly evil. After Vivian hired Dr. Dane Gavin to capture the creature, Carolyn accompanied the expedition that successfully imprisoned the Man-Thing inside an electrified sphere and transported it to New York City for public exhibition. While the creature was displayed at the Museum of Natural History, Carolyn witnessed firsthand how the fear of the crowds caused the Man-Thing to become increasingly unstable and violent. As the creature weakened away from its natural environment, Carolyn realized that the Man-Thing was suffering rather than intentionally acting as a monster. Convinced it was not responsible for her father’s death in the way her mother believed, Carolyn persuaded Vivian and Dr. Gavin to return the Man-Thing to the Florida swamps before it died. Her compassion ultimately helped end the crisis and saved the creature’s life.

carolyn trainer.name: Carolyn Trainer
carolyn trainer.species: Human, technology user; Dr. Otto Octavius's favorite student
carolyn trainer.origin: During the Clone Saga, Dr. Otto Octavius was killed by Kaine and was replaced not long after, by Carolyn Trainer, daughter of Seward Trainer, an adoring student of Octavius. She obtained a set of four tentacles identical to Octavius' and made use of a personal force-field that kept anything from hitting her. (However, her tentacles could lash out from the shield at any time during its use.) She took the name Doctor Octopus in honor of her beloved instructor, the original Dr. Octopus. When she found her father was being protected by the Scarlet Spider, she became jealous of the father-son relationship between him and her father. Her attempts to claim her father's then-comatose body resulted in her defeat and capture by the police. Later, she was involved in the resurrection of Otto Octavius. thumb|left After Octavius was brought back to life by the cult known as the Hand, Trainer returned the tentacles to him. She then joined him as an assistant and faded into the background for him to move forward. She was hired by Lucia von Bardas as a part of a plan to get vengeance on Nick Fury, who used numerous superheroes to attack Latveria. She and a new Hobgoblin were commanded to attack Captain America. She was later seen rampaging through New York, where she was quickly defeated by Ronin and Mockingbird. Lady Octopus was among several animal-themed super-villains captured by Taskmaster and Black Ant to serve as hunting targets in Central Park for Kraven the Hunter, Arcade, and a host of wealthy participants controlling robotic drones. Vulture quickly appointed himself as leader of the surviving criminals, and led Lady Octopus and the others to safety. Soon after, the force field holding the criminals inside of Central Park deactivated, and Lady Octopus presumably escaped. When the Beetle founded an all-female criminal enterprise named the Syndicate, Lady Octopus was part of it. Together, they went after Boomerang for revenge. After Beetle arranged behind her partners' back to hand him over to the Kingpin, the entirety of the Syndicate felt compelled to help him evade arrest when he disclosed that he was trying to keep the pieces of the Lifeline Tablet out of Fisk's hands. The Syndicate were subsequently apprehended, but Beetle broke them out of police custody. Not long afterward, Beetle was kidnapped by Madame Masque and Crime Master due to being the daughter of Tombstone. Tombstone enlisted the help of the Syndicate to rescue her and her boyfriend Randy Robertson. In the process, Lady Octopus and her teammates unwillingly teamed up with Spider-Man again, who was also helping foil Masque's and Crime Master's plans. As part of his final attack against Spider-Man, the demonic Kindred abducted numerous villains that had been recently involved in the hero's life and implanted parasites in their brains to force them to do his bidding, including Lady Octopus. After capturing Spider-Man, Kindred let the villains loose on the hero, having promised that whoever killed the Web-Slinger was the only one to escape eternal damnation at his hands. The villains waged war against Spider-Man and each other until Doctor Octopus managed to broadcast an ultrasonic frequency that killed the parasites inside every villain's brain, neutralizing Kindred's only leverage on them, but also knocking all of them unconscious.

carpathian.name: Carpathian
carpathian.origin: Carpathian was a vampire recruited into the Legion of the Unliving, a group of vampires under Dracula's direction who feigned dissidence against him as part of his plan to start the vampire kingdom anew. This scheme involved the purging of the vampire community, weeding out the weaker members of the race. Carpathian worked for the Legion of the Unliving solely to sate his bloodlust and in exchange of being kept fed. The Legion of the Unliving came to blows with the Avengers during their crusade; once in Madripoor where the Legion was carrying out part of their massacre, and later at the Sol-Iletsk Federal Penal Colony No. 9 in Russia, where the Legion infected all inmates in order to build up the ranks of the new vampire kingdom. Most members of the Legion of the Unliving, including Carpathian, managed to evade the Avengers and fled to Chernobyl, where Dracula was going to set up his new domain.

carradine.name: Carradine
carradine.origin: ===The Most Vile Murder=== left|thumb|The first conviction of the Burglar While in prison, Carradine shared a cell with the infamous gangster Dutch Mallone. Due to his insomnia, he managed to overhear Mallone talking in his sleep about a house and the treasure hidden within it. the Burglar got out of prison shortly after Mallone died in his cell. Once outside, he discovered the location of the house Dutch Mallone had spoken of. Some time later, the Burglar robbed a television studio in Manhattan. At his escape he encountered Spider-Man, who didn't stop him, allowing him to escape via the elevator. A few days later, he burglarized the Parker household. He grabbed May Parker, believing that she could lead him to the hidden fortune, but her husband Ben Parker intervened. The Burglar shot Ben and fled the scene. When he hid from the police in a warehouse, he was caught by Spider-Man. The web-slinger recognized him and turned him over to the police. ===The Return of the Burglar=== Several years later, Carradine was paroled from prison. He learned that May had moved and was renting out her old house. He rented the house and spent the following weeks dismantling it, but he couldn't find the treasure. The Burglar visited Dr. Ludwig Rinehart at the Restwell residence to threaten him. Though initially opposed to helping, Rinehart eventually agreed, and they both planned how to get rid of May's nephew to know more about the treasure. Rinehart successfully faked May Parker's death and convinced Peter Parker of his aunt's demise. However, the Burglar refused to give him his share of the treasure, and Rinehart revealed himself as the villain Mysterio. Mysterio kept Carradine in the basement alongside May, continuing to torment him for more information about the treasure. Carradine refused to reveal any more, so Mysterio investigated the house on his own and later subdued Spider-Man enough to temporarily strip him of his powers. Mysterio then abandoned his search for Mallone's treasure and his nursing home scheme. right|thumb|The death of the Burglar The Burglar eventually broke free and sought out Peter Parker at his apartment. They struggled until Peter was knocked out and the Burglar took him to a warehouse. When Peter woke up, the Burglar told his story and then struck him in an attempt to extract information. Peter refused, so Carradine returned to the nursing home to retrieve May, believing that seeing her alive and in danger would motivate Peter to talk. He was confronted at the nursing home by Spider-Man. The Burglar shot Spider-Man, grazing him. He then abducted May and took her to the warehouse. Before he could use May to threaten Peter, he discovered that Peter was no longer tied up and had gone. Spider-Man arrived and the two men fought. In the midst of the battle, Spider-Man revealed his identity, shocking the Burglar. Carradine tried to escape but suffered a sudden heart attack that ended his life. Spider-Man took May to a hospital where she was treated. As Peter, he talked with his aunt and learned that the Dutch Mallone's treasure had been eaten by silverfish many years ago.

carrie alexander.name: Carrie Alexander
carrie alexander.origin: Carrie Alexander was the daughter of Caleb Alexander, an oceanographer obsessed with Namor, the avenging son of Atlantis also known as the Sub-Mariner. She became a partner to her father in his adventures on high seas after his health deteriorated due to a heart condition. Following rumors of Namor's demise, the Alexanders patrolled the Pacific Ocean aboard their ship named Oracle. By chance, Namor stumbled upon the father-daughter team of researchers, exhibiting his usual insanity. Caleb Alexander took the opportunity to test his method to calm Namor down by stabilizing his oxygen levels. In gratitude, Namor proposed a partnership with the Alexanders. Determined to preserve the oceans, he raided sunken treasures to finance his purchase a conglomerate he renamed Oracle Inc., using the Alexanders as proxy buyers and managers. Namor also demonstrated his infatuation with Carrie Alexander. The emergence of Oracle sparked the interest of rival competitors, the twins Phoebe and Desmond Marrs. An incident sparked by the Marrs caused the monstrous Griffin to kidnap Carrie Alexander. In order to protect his daughter, Caleb Alexander fought back, but experienced a heart attack. Namor rescued her, but the attack made the Alexanders question their position at Oracle, Inc. Despite Namor having professed his lover for her, Carrie Alexander departed from Oracle Inc. Having recovered on a cruise, the Alexanders wished to return to Oracle to help Namor face the corporation's problems. After Namor saved them from the monstrosity Sluj, the Alexanders fully returned to Oracle. Carrie expressed her concerns about Phoebe Marrs becoming close to Namor, not trusting her intentions. Despite becoming more distant from Namor, Carrie Alexander still accompanied him in his adventures. She was able to visit Atlantis and the Savage Land. While Carrie was away, Caleb Alexander was brutally assaulted by Desmond Marrs when he questioned a sabotage attempt. Upon learning about the incident, Carrie became terribly distressed with Phoebe Marrs' proximity to Namor and Oracle Inc. Carrie cared for her father while he was in a coma for months until he eventually passed away.

carrion crow.name: Carrion Crow
carrion crow.origin: The being known as the Carrion Crow was Native American trickster deity who beared great magic and acted as the harbinger of messages from the beyond. During the Chaos King's campaign to destroy all of existence, the Carrion Crow was one of the countless deities who fell under his service. Learning of the possibility that one of the diaries written by Destiny may contain the key to his defeat, the Chaos King sent the Carrion Crow to claim it and destroy it. The Carrion Crow sent his ravens to look for it through the ruins of the X-Mansion, only to find the resurrected Thunderbird, Banshee, Dr. Moira MacTaggert, Multiple Man's dupes, Esme and Sophie Cuckoo. Seeing that they had already found the diary, Carrion Crow attacked them, forcing Thunderbird to pray to his god of the same name to open a portal for them to escape. Everyone managed to pass through the portal, except for Sophie as she was taken by the ravens. Soon Carrion Crow manifested before her, and planning to use her to track down the other X-Men, transformed Sophie into his minion. Carrion Crow sent Sophie and his crows to track down the X-Men, and eventually found them on Muir Island. As the island was a nexus that connected to the divine spirits of creation, Carrion Crow opened a portal for Sophie and his crows to attack the heroes and prevent them from unleashing the spirits against the Chaos King. Sophia fought Esme, and during their fight she momentarily came to her senses and instructed her sister to kill her as Carrion Crow had imbued with much of his power. Esme refused as she also transformed into corvine being due to their shared connection, while the rest of the X-Men fought the crows. Before going through the portal himself, Carrion Crow threw bursts of energy to take down the heroes, until Banshee unleashed a sonic screech at him and the portal, leaving the evil deity staggered and the portal destroyed. However, Carrion Crow still managed to arrive and confronted the X-Men mocking them all for believing they had a chance to win as they had inadvertently led him to the source of creation. He made quick of the Cuckoo sisters, slowly approached Moira, who was currently possessed by Destiny's spirit. Banshee tried to stall his advance with his sonic screams, while Destiny told Carrion Crow that his victory wasn't yet guaranteed and encouraged Thunderbird to call upon the power of his namesake. Sadly, Banshee eventually ran out of breath, allowing Carrion Crow to directly face him and Moira, and with another burst of energy he killed them. Fortunately, Thunderbird merged with the avatar of his god and divinely empowered he fought the Carrion Crow. Despite boasting that this would be all in vain, Carrion Crow was ultimately destroyed by Thunderbird who proceeded to chanel the energies of creation to help turn the tide of the existential war in the heroes' favor.

carson bells.name: Carson Bells
carson bells.origin: Carson Bells was an American actor who was at the height of his popularity in the 1940s. In the early 1940s, he promoted the purchase of war bonds, and in January of 1943, he made an appearance in Freetown to put on a performance about the dangers of the Third Reich should they invade the United States. However, Nazi spies attempted to eliminate his actors portraying Nazis by carbon monoxide poisoning. Taking their place, they kidnapped Carson and took him to a nearby mill. The only person who realized the truth was young Roddy Colt, who was secretly the costumed hero the Secret Stamp. As Roddy searched for Carson in his costumed identity, the Nazis threatened to kill the actor if he did not agree to get 50 thousand dollars from the film studio that employed him. The Secret Stamp had located the spies and freed Bells. When the lights were put out, Bells assisted the Secret Stamp in an unconventional way: using his ventriloquism skills, he confused the Nazis, allowing the Stamp to beat them into submission. After the spies were defeated and being taken to the authorities, the Secret Stamp told Bells that his "friend" Roddy Colt deserved the credit. By the time Bells was rescued, his studio had offered a one million dollar reward to anyone who safely rescued him. Roddy was rewarded the money, but he quickly donated the full amount to the war bond charity that Bells had organized. By the time the drive in Freetown was over, Bells had collected over two million dollars for the defense effort. His subsequent activities are unrevealed.

The only person who realized the truth was young Roddy Colt, who was secretly the costumed hero the Secret Stamp. As Roddy searched for Carson in his costumed identity, the Nazis threatened to kill the actor if he did not agree to get 50 thousand dollars from the film studio that employed him. The Secret Stamp had located the spies and freed Bells. When the lights were put out, Bells assisted the Secret Stamp in an unconventional way: using his ventriloquism skills, he confused the Nazis, allowing the Stamp to beat them into submission. After the spies were defeated and being taken to the authorities, the Secret Stamp told Bells that his "friend" Roddy Colt deserved the credit. By the time Bells was rescued, his studio had offered a one million dollar reward to anyone who safely rescued him. Roddy was rewarded the money, but he quickly donated the full amount to the war bond charity that Bells had organized. By the time the drive in Freetown was over, Bells had collected over two million dollars for the defense effort. His subsequent activities are unrevealed.

carson knowles.name: Carson Knowles
carson knowles.origin: thumb|left|200px|Carson Knowles Carson Knowles was a veteran who returned home without applause. His job had been passed on, and his wife left him with their son. He barely got by as a deliveryman and found out his son was killed by phone. After his car was stripped for parts and a mugger accosted him, Knowles snapped and beat the man nearly to death. Seeking to destroy the city that treated him so badly, Carson Knowles ran as a dark horse candidate for mayor on his father's name and political connections. He also created a second identity as Black Spectre, beating and blackmailing the local precinct boss to support Knowles. In a fight with Moon Knight, his mask slipped, but Moon Knight was unable to convince anyone that Mayoral Candidate Knowles and Black Spectre were one and the same. Eventually, Moon Knight defeated Black Spectre in public and his assistant Marlene Alraune uncovered Knowles corrupt plans for the city in his political office. He was released from prison years later but was constantly challenged by his co-workers and a corrupt probation officer. He succumbed to the trappings of his former life as the Black Spectre and decided to get his revenge on Moon Knight by killing his victims and carving a crescent shape into their forehead, thus implicating Moon Knight. He then revealed himself to Moon Knight and after beating him stole Stark nanotechnology and infected a group of citizens celebrating the 50-State Initiative. He then brutally beat Mark to near death and revealed that using the nanites, he would command the entire crowd to commit suicide as all he wanted was the world to burn for his son's death and mistreating him. Moon Knight, unable to walk and with no time to stop him from doing so, pulled his leg and caused him to fall off the rooftop of the building above the crowd. He appeared to die on impact. Black Spectre and other villains who died fighting Moon Knight were later revived and recruited by Jackal Knight to become his version of the Legion of the Unliving in a plot to kill Moon Knight as he was trying to return the soul of Khalil Nasser, mortal host of the god Osiris, to his body. Jackal Knight's scheme was thwarted when Nasser sacrificed himself to free Osiris.

carter blaire.name: Carter Blaire
carter blaire.origin: ===Early Life=== While studying law, Carter Blaire met and married Katherine, an aspiring entertainer whose free-spirited personality contrasted sharply with his own reserved and ambitious nature. Katherine worked to support Carter while he completed his education, and the couple had a daughter, Alison. Their marriage gradually deteriorated as Carter devoted increasing amounts of time to establishing his legal career. Katherine felt ignored and restricted by him, while Carter disapproved of her continuing interest in show business. Katherine began an affair with musician Nicholas Brown and eventually left Carter and the young Alison. Carter subsequently raised Alison with the assistance of his mother, Bella Blaire. Bitter over Katherine's departure, Carter refused to discuss her with Alison and allowed his daughter to grow up believing that her mother had simply abandoned her. ===Estrangement from Alison=== Carter maintained a strict household and attempted to control many aspects of Alison's upbringing. When Alison wanted to attend a dance during junior high school, Carter initially refused to give his permission, although Bella eventually persuaded him to relent. During the dance, Alison's latent mutant ability to convert sound into light manifested for the first time, although those present assumed that the resulting light show had been produced by special-effects equipment. As Alison grew older, Carter expected her to follow him into the legal profession. Alison attended law school to satisfy him but remained determined to become a professional singer. When she abandoned her legal studies to pursue music, Carter repeatedly urged her to reconsider. Unable to accept her decision, he regarded it as a rejection of both himself and everything he had worked to provide for her. Alison later returned to the family home in the hope of repairing their relationship. Bella welcomed her, but Carter remained angry and rejected her attempt at reconciliation. Despite his outward hostility, he became deeply concerned when Alison subsequently disappeared. Carter nevertheless suppressed his feelings and resisted Bella's attempts to make him acknowledge how much he cared about his daughter. Carter later discovered that Bella had continued communicating with Alison despite his wishes. The two argued, with Carter insisting that Alison had chosen to be on her own when she rejected the life he had planned for her. He also compared Alison's stubbornness and attraction to show business with Katherine's behaviour. Although Carter continued presenting himself as unforgiving, Bella found him sitting alone and brooding over Alison, demonstrating that their estrangement was causing him considerable emotional distress. Another attempt to reconcile Carter and Alison proved unsuccessful, while Bella remained caught between her son and granddaughter. ===Breakdown and Reconciliation=== Alison possessed only fragmentary memories of Katherine and eventually began searching for her missing mother. Alison's friend Warren Worthington III also investigated Katherine's disappearance and questioned Bella about what had happened. The renewed attention given to Katherine aggravated Carter's deteriorating emotional condition. Carter became increasingly distracted while presiding over court proceedings and began muttering about Katherine in the courtroom. His condition became sufficiently obvious that a bailiff persuaded him to call a recess, while lawyers who had known Carter as a respected judge remarked upon the decline in his mental health. He subsequently suffered a complete psychological breakdown and withdrew into an almost entirely unresponsive, catatonic state. Bella obtained psychiatric assistance for him, but the attending doctor was unable to identify an effective treatment. Believing she might be able to reach him, Alison returned home and confronted her father. Her presence finally brought Carter out of his stupor, but also revived his feelings of betrayal. Carter told Alison his account of his marriage, describing Katherine's affair with Nicholas Brown and her involvement with alcohol and drugs. He admitted that his opposition to Alison's singing career had been motivated by his fear that show business would cause her to follow the same path as her mother. Alison angrily confronted Carter for concealing the truth and attempting to dictate the course of her life. Nevertheless, their candid exchange allowed father and daughter to begin repairing their relationship. Carter later attended Alison's charity concert, unaware that Katherine—now living under the name Barbara Londonwas also present. Afterwards, Carter went through Katherine's remaining possessions in the attic. He packed them into a box addressed to Barbara London and finally allowed himself to cry over the end of their marriage. His relief at still being capable of feeling such grief marked the beginning of his emotional recovery. Carter was later confronted in his judicial cha

carter dyam.name: Carter Dyam
carter dyam.origin: Brightsword was previously known as Carter Dyam. His father was a Zionist who came to Israel at fifteen, in 1921, got married there, raised a family, and was eventually killed during the Six-Day War. At 24, in the early 1970s, he was part of Israeli military who had grown disillusioned with warfare and killing. When approached by the Asgardian god Heimdall to become one of the Young Gods, he accepted and represented the warrior among them. When the High Evolutionary launch his Evolutionary War, he came to visit the Young Gods because of their perfect genetics, but was disappointed and retreat, deciding to avoid them from his plans. However, Daydreamer's precognition informed them from the incoming Genocide, causing the Gods to split in two sides: The non-interferers from a side, and the interferers, including Brightsword who didn't wanted to see the Holocaust reproduced. Those teleported to the High Evolutionary's place and helped Spider-Man against the Purifiers but were soon rejoined by the rest of the squad who battle them.

carter ghazikhanian.name: Carter Ghazikhanian
carter ghazikhanian.origin: Carter Ghazikhanian is the son of an unknown mutant and Annie Ghazikhanian, the once resident nurse at the Xavier Institute for Higher Learning. While at the school, Carter struck up a friendship with the young aquatic mutant named Samuel "Sammy" Paré aka "Squid Boy". When Carter tried to help Alex Summers, the X-Man known as "Havok", from his coma, something strange occurred which rendered Carter unconscious. His conscious became ensnared by the evil counterpart of Havok from the Mutant X universe, but Carter and the real Alex were rescued by Professor X, who after the rescue wanted to talk to Annie about Carter's father. The identity of Carter's father is yet to be revealed. Annie later took him away from the Xavier Institute when she found it a too dangerous place for him, when the new Brotherhood of Evil Mutants led by the ex-Acolyte Exodus, attacked the Institute, killing Sammy and other mutants. As Annie and Carter were shown leaving the Institute, the astral projection of an undetermined person was shown next to Carter's face. Annie seemed unaware of this projection. Carter's dialogue and expression at this time hint that he is under the control of this individual. Whether or not Carter retained his mutant powers after the effect of M-Day has yet to be revealed. The subsequent fate of Carter has yet to be revealed, but his mother was with Iceman when he met up with his ex girlfriends, while she was working at a soup kitchen.

While at the school, Carter struck up a friendship with the young aquatic mutant named Samuel "Sammy" Paré aka "Squid Boy". When Carter tried to help Alex Summers, the X-Man known as "Havok", from his coma, something strange occurred which rendered Carter unconscious. His conscious became ensnared by the evil counterpart of Havok from the Mutant X universe, but Carter and the real Alex were rescued by Professor X, who after the rescue wanted to talk to Annie about Carter's father. The identity of Carter's father is yet to be revealed. Annie later took him away from the Xavier Institute when she found it a too dangerous place for him, when the new Brotherhood of Evil Mutants led by the ex-Acolyte Exodus, attacked the Institute, killing Sammy and other mutants. As Annie and Carter were shown leaving the Institute, the astral projection of an undetermined person was shown next to Carter's face. Annie seemed unaware of this projection. Carter's dialogue and expression at this time hint that he is under the control of this individual. Whether or not Carter retained his mutant powers after the effect of M-Day has yet to be revealed. The subsequent fate of Carter has yet to be revealed, but his mother was with Iceman when he met up with his ex girlfriends, while she was working at a soup kitchen.

carter kounen.name: Carter Kounen
carter kounen.origin: Carter Kounen was a familiar of the House of Damaskinos. He served as a lawyer and human face for Eli Damaskinos while publicly visible under the European Health Consortium. Kounen was present at the first meeting between Blade and the vampire overlord, Eli Damaskinos. Unlike most familiars, he carried significant influence within the vampire ranks and contributed a substantial portion of the information given to Blade. He was later seen commanding a squad of private security troops in a containment and capture operation in the sewers of Prague where he had Blade captured and brought before Damaskinos. This led to Kounen personally conducting a blood siphoning operation on the vampire hunter, although before he could proceed with the process he was interrupted by the sound a general alert, then shot dead by Blade's ally, Whistler.

carter napier.name: Carter Napier
carter napier.origin: Dr. Napier was research scientist who was recruited by the Commission on Superhuman Activities in an attempt to create super-human spider-based powers in operatives. One of their first test subjects was Julia Carpenter. Carpenter was not fully aware of the intended effects but was a willing participant. She eventually developed powers and donned the identity of Spider-Woman. When the project to create spider-heroes was shut down, Napier was bribed by the Manipulator to create Deathweb. When he discovered that Deathweb intended to use Carpenter's parents, Walter and Elizabeth Cornwall to locate more serum to further enhance their abilities. Unfortunately, before he could warn them, Therak injected him with a deadly dose of venom and he died.

carter ryking.name: Carter Ryking
carter ryking.origin: Brian Xavier, Kurt Marko, and Hazard's father Alexander Ryking were all part of a secret mutant research project called Black Womb at Alamogordo, New Mexico. This was of special interest to Ryking as his son Carter had demonstrated mutant powers that he had trouble controlling. Carter was kept sedated and was outfitted with bionics in an attempt to help control his powers. He remained at the hospital until word reached of his father's death. Carter killed the nurses handling him then secretly sent a file with history on their fathers' project to Professor X. This was discovered by Wolverine, who was looking through Xavier's files for information on his own past. At Alexander's funeral, Hazard appeared to forcibly take Xavier to Alamogordo. Alerted by Valerie Cooper, the X-Men followed them. Hazard's firing mechanisms were damaged by Cyclops (Scott Summers), causing an energy buildup. Xavier mind-linked with Carter enough to limit the damage to most of the secret facility. With Carter weakened, Wolverine tried to interrogate him about S.H.I.V.A. Xavier remarked that the truth about the past came from where someone lived, not where they died, and the X-Men left. Hazard was later contacted by the woman known as Fontanelle through his dreams. Fontanelle was gathering information about Gambit for her employer, the New Son, but the nature of the link between Hazard and Gambit is unknown. Following M-Day, Carter was one of the millions of mutants who were left depowered. Driven insane by his loss in power, he was locked in a room at the Ryking Institute, where he began counting down to his own death. Shortly after a visit from Charles Xavier, on a quest to recover his lost memories, Carter was mysteriously killed while guards attempted to sedate him. Prior to his death, however, he allowed Xavier to read his mind, allowing Xavier to recall that their fathers' worked alongside Dr. Milbury, who performed genetic testing on the two boys, and who would later become known as Mister Sinister.

carter slade.name: Carter Slade
carter slade.origin: Carter Slade was born and raised in Ohio in the mid-19th century, along with his brother Lincoln. Eventually Carter decided to move out west to the new territories, in order to become a schoolteacher at the new settlement of Bison Bend in Colorado. However, when he had nearly arrived he came upon a group of what appeared to be Indians slaughtering helpless homesteaders. Though he was untrained in using a gun, he had been a boxing champion in college and, at any rate, could not allow such an atrocity to go unchallenged. Riding into the fray he discovered the attackers were not Indians but rather white men dressed up to appear as Indians. They were cattle herders upset at settlers coming in and taking what they regarded as their land, despite the government's role in placing settlers. Though he fought bravely, Carter was eventually defeated, shot multiple times and slowly dying from his injuries. It was then that Jamie Jacobs, the teenage son of the settlers who had been murdered, emerged from his hiding place and found him. Surmising what had happened, Jamie managed to get Carter onto a horse and set out to find help. However, he was travelling in the wrong direction and after many long hours collapsed to the ground. However, a group of friendly Indians had been watching and took Jacobs and Slade to their medicine man, Flaming Star. Flaming Star had, many years before, seen a shooting star fall from the sky, bringing with it a bounty of phosphorescent dust. Flaming Star took this as a sign from the Great Spirit, and learned that a champion would one day be sent to him, to fight injustice using the glowing dust and a special cape he had prepared. Flaming Star prayed, chanted and prepared potions and herbs for three days, but was about to give up on Carter when suddenly Carter's fever broke and he awoke, seemingly fully restored to health. It was then that Flaming Star realized Carter Slade was the champion sent to him to fight injustice. He gave Carter the cloak he had fashioned, which was reversible and had a pitch-black lining to complement the bright, white outer side. He also gave Carter all of the phosphorescent dust and led him to an untameable white horse that Carter managed to secure, and which he named Banshee for its distinctive neigh. Carter then created an entire costume to complement the cloak and horse, and christened himself the Ghost Rider, though later others began calling him other names, such as the Night Rider and the Phantom Rider. His first act as the Phantom Rider was to bring the men responsible for killing Jamie Jacobs's parents to justice, a group of cattle herders led by a man named Jason Bartholomew. He then set about helping the folk of Bison Bend erect a schoolhouse and took Jamie under his wing as his ward/adopted son. Over the next decade Carter Slade rode the West fighting evil with Bison Bend as his base of operations, fighting and defeating a number of would-be criminals, including the Sting-Ray, who formerly had fought the Rawhide Kid under the name Scorpion. In time, Carter began to fall in love with a young woman by the name of Natalie Brooks, sister of the sheriff, Ben Brooks. However, any relationship between them was complicated by the fact that Ben Brooks irrationally believed the Phantom Rider to be an evil man, bent on taking over the territory. Additionally, Natalie was engaged to be married to a man named Clay Riley, whom Slade would eventually find out was the criminal known as the Tarantula. As the Tarantula, Riley dressed in purplish-black and used an eight-headed bullwhip as his weapon of choice. He and the Rider clashed multiple times, eventually leading to a confrontation that would change Carter's life. Carter had decided to visit Ben Brooks in the form of the Phantom Rider to try and convince him he was in error in believing the Rider to be evil. However, at the same time the Tarantula set fire to several local buildings, and in the chaos Natalie ran into her brother's home to warn him of what had happened. Ben Brooks tried to use the distraction as a chance to shoot and kill the Rider but Natalie, whose life had been saved several times by Slade in the guise of the Phantom Rider, jumped in between the two men. Sheriff Brooks instinctively fired his gun at the motion and shot Natalie, severing her spinal cord. She was eventually stabilized but unless she received emergency surgery in Denver it was determined she would never walk again. Ben Brooks and Clay Riley then set out with Natalie in tow, unknowingly being followed by Carter Slade. En route, Carter was attacked and knocked unconscious by a deluded old man who lived in the mountains. This man also found Brooks and Riley and was about to kill them when he saw Natalie. In his madness he mistook her for his wife, who had died over ten years ago, and kidnapped her. In his absence, Carter switched to his Phantom Rider outfit and was able to thwart the crazy man. fields.notes: The Phantom Rider (at the time called Ghost Rider), was originally co-created by Dick Ayers in 1949 while working for Magazine Enterprises. In this incarnation, the Ghost Rider was Federal Marshal Rex Fury, assisted by his sidekick Sing Song. Renowned for its artwork and many Frank Frazetta covers, this series was very popular and branched into horror many times. This version of the Ghost Rider appeared in more than 200 stories before the Comics Code shut him down in the mid-50s. When Ayers began working for Marvel Comics in the 60s, he revived the Ghost Rider with a new secret identity and mythos. Later, Rex Fury would be revealed to had existed in the Earth-616. The Phantom Rider (the character, and subsequently the mantle) was originally known as the Ghost Rider. The name was changed when Marvel introduced a new character named Ghost Rider, the hellfire-tossing, bike-riding alter-ego of Johnny Blaze, who was powered by the Spirit of Vengeance. The character's name was first changed to "Night Rider" in the 70s, and ultimately "Phantom Rider." One issue of West Coast Avengers used all three names interchangeably, and the handbook on Western heroes titled did the same. Despite the previous use (and occasional reuse) of the "Ghost Rider" name, and the fact that both the Phantom Rider and the Ghost Rider are mantles used by numerous characters connected by their respective mantle, there is no direct connection between the mythos of the Phantom Rider(s) and the Ghost Rider(s). Slade appears in TSR, Inc.'s RPG adventure The Weird, Weird West, and is a playable character at certain points of the plot. In the plot, he had forged an alliance with Kid Colt, Two-Gun Kid and Rawhide Kid due to a time crisis that had eventually left 1871 Dodge City raided by Tyrannosaurus Rex. The western heroes had met time traveler Albert Einstein and decided to help him find a solution to the crisis, protecting him from "Faro" John Hobart's desperado gang while he worked. An initial fight with the player character's time traveling heroes eventually led to an alliance where the western heroes helped them to forge an alliance with three warring generals (Alexander the Great, Napoleon Bonaparte, and Genghis Khan) against a common alien threat.
fields.trivia: There are some "Western Ghost Rider" statues floating around depicting a hellfire-type character in a Western-style outfit, all in black. A Phantom Rider appeared briefly in among hundreds of Ghost Riders from different times.

carter torino.name: Carter Torino
carter torino.origin: Carter is the grandson of Berto Torino, the head of the New York City's Torino Crime Family, but unlike his family Carter has no criminal tendency and is unaware of the criminal activities of his family. In love with Gwen Stacy, Carter was thwarted by her father, police Captain George Stacy, convinced that an apple can not fall far from its tree, and then he too would become a criminal. With time, however, even Captain Stacy was convinced of the good intentions of Carter and accepted his relationship with his daughter.

cartier st croix.name: Cartier St. Croix
cartier st croix.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|left|St. Croix Family Cartier St. Croix is the son of Louis St. Croix. He is a rich and eccentric man, a wealthy former president of several corporations from Monaco, and an ambassador. As his father before him, Cartier joined the Xavier's Mutant Underground. He married a descendant of Algerian royalty, and she bore them a son, Marius. Their second child was a daughter Monet, who quickly became Cartier's favourite child. A few years later his wife gave birth to twins Claudette and Nicole. Claudette suffered from autism, and despite Cartier spending large sums of money on her treatment, her condition would remain unchanged. While Cartier was out with his daughters, Marius' mutant powers manifested for the first time. His wife tried to help their son, but overcome by his newly awakened hunger, Marius killed her. When Cartier found out what his son had done, he angrily kicked his son out. Sometime later, Marius returned, to offer Monet a place at his side. Monet scornfully rejected him, prompting Marius to turn her into a mute, razor-skinned creature called "Penance". The twins caught Marius in the act, and banished him to a hellish dimension, dragging Penance with him. Afraid of what would happen to Cartier if he found out what had happened to his beloved daughter, the twins began posing as her by using their mutant powers to merge into her. ===Generation X=== "Monet" was soon kidnapped by the Phalanx, and after she was rescued, Cartier sent her to the Massachusetts Academy run by Emma Frost and Sean Cassidy. When Monet was freed from the Penance body, Cartier came to the academy to visit his daughters. When he learned that Marius, who had been captured by Generation X, was there as well, a remorseful Cartier attempted to make peace with his son, believing he had been rash to throw him out. Marius refused to reconcile with his father however, and appears to have escaped the academy before Cartier could make any headway in reconciling them. In an effort to bring his family closer together, he decided to take his daughters home. He sent Monet to study in Switzerland, but when she asked to return to the academy, Cartier allowed her to. ===X-Factor=== When Monet attracted the attention of Baron Mordo, who suffered from cancer and needed to drain Monet's life essence in order to be cured, he kidnapped Cartier in order to force Monet to cooperate with his plans. Monet, with the help of Strong Guy, managed to rescue her father, and used her telepathy to trick Mordo into believing that he had drained her. After this ordeal, Cartier seemingly returned to Monaco.

He dealt with Spider-Man, Wolverine, and Daredevil who were coming after a monster that was a member of his sect. He later joined the Theater of Pain and faced off with the Marauders. He was then saved by the Marauders and given sanctuary on Krakoa along with all the former followers of Brimstone Love.

carver robertson.name: Carver Robertson
carver robertson.first_appearance: Spider-Man Noir: Eyes Without a Face Vol 1 1
carver robertson.origin: Carver Robertson is the father of Robbie Robertson, and a close friend of the Parkers. During the Depression, Robertson normally supported for the Republicans but instead voted for Democrat Franklin Roosevelt after hearing his economic recovery plan. When Robbie was missing, Carver and his son's girlfriend Gloria meet with the Parker's and shared their grave distress believing that Robbie has been captured or killed by the American Nazi-sympathizer organization, the Friends of Germany. Indeed this was true, as Robbie was tragically detained and lobotomized by Dr. Otto Octavius. Leaving him into a permanent zombified state. Carver and Gloria were left to take care what was left of his son.

cary albertson.name: Cary Albertson
cary albertson.origin: Cary Albertson was a research scientist who worked for Roxxon to develop a biochip that would allow for tracking and communication when implanted in soldiers. Working with General Chasen of the Canadian Army, the biochip was proposed to be used by members of the fledgling Alpha Flight. However, Albertson and Chasen implemented a secret "control" element which allow for people with the chip to essentially be puppets under someone else's control. Vindicator, after discovering this, went to the facility to destroy the manufacturing equipment. However, he lost control of his power suit and thought Albertson may have been responsible. Albertson was severely injured when debris fell on him. At the same time, Vindicator regained control of his suit seemingly verifying his control over Vindicator. Albertson was taken to hospital It was later "revealed" that Chasen had given Roxxon the information necessary to control Vindicator's suit. However, this was a plot by Chasen and General Clarke to convince Vindicator of the need for an implant to track the members of Alpha Flight in case one goes rogue or is taken over like he was. Vindicator goes on to design a new biochip implant and convince his team to use them. It's unclear if Chasen ever truly gave Roxxon Vindicator's suit designs and Albertson controlled him or if Chasen himself was in control of the suit.

cary armstrong.name: Cary Armstrong
cary armstrong.origin: Armstrong was a government agent who was critically injured while protecting a dignitary from the mercenary group Shadowforce Alpha. He was saved by Dr. Noah Purl using the regenerative therapy pioneered by Curt Connors. The operation was successful, and he gained superhuman strength and durability. He then teamed up with Scarlet Spider against Shadowforce Alpha and a creature that was mistaken for the Lizard, the alter ego of Curt Connors. Armstrong was dubbed Strongarm by a journalist who misheard his last name. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

cary dekum.name: Cary Dekum
cary dekum.origin: Kit Sekum flew past in the MiG, but as the jet broke the sound barrier it disappeared. Furthermore, Kit was not carrying a triangle, so he was subject to the uncanny radiation of the Corridor - which seemed to turn his cells transparent. And since time and space were altered within the Corridor, breaking the sound barrier was enough to trap Sekum in a closed chronal loop, bouncing back and forth around the Corridor except for brief periods when he popped up at both ends - and Marvel Boy gave their superiors the time and place of a teleporting MiG, which they thought was a threat. The heroes rushed to save Kit Sekum, but the Air Force didn't get the message in time and the plane was destroyed.

cary st lawrence.name: Cary St. Lawrence
cary st lawrence.origin: Cary graduated third in her class at West Point Academy, despite "Thunderbolt" Ross dismissing her prospects of a successful military career. With Doc Samson, she approached Hulk on Broadway and ordered the Thunderbolts to take him down when he refused to surrender. She eventually realized that the Hulk would only get stronger the more enraged he became, making her original brute force tactics pointless. Cary switched to more subtle strategies when trying to calm the Hulk. Some time later, she assisted Dr. Banner when he was trying, in vain, to cure his wife Betty of lethal radiation exposure.

casey kinmont.name: Casey Kinmont
casey kinmont.origin: Casey was caught up in an investigation by Doctor Strange, during a baseball game where the original team had made a deal with a demon that the current team inherited. Doctor Strange enchanted her glasses so she could see the magic around her. Unable to use his hands correctly, Doctor Strange also taught her a simple removal spell. They were able to save the team at the cost of Casey's grandfather Bill Kinmont. Afterwards, Casey kept her enchanted glasses and began to abuse the Removal spell Doctor Strange had taught her, actively seeking him out. Finally finding him, she was shocked to learn that the spell she was using dumped the objects she spelled into another dimension Doctor Strange had agreed with. The demon there wanted justice, but Doctor Strange bargained for her freedom at the request the spell not be used again. Casey then was drawn into an adventure when an old demon associate of Doctor Strange named Larry appeared and asked for his assistance tangling with another demon who was stealing the souls of young beauty pageant contestants. Casey, spelled to look like a contestant, thwarted the demon's scheme at the cost of the loss of her soul. Before she could retrieve it, a magic catastrophe occurred and Strange was forced to repair the damage on the astral plane, leaving Casey to guard his body. An old enemy of Doctor Strange appeared, calling himself Silver Dagger, and began to attack Strange's body. At this time Larry, trapped in another dimension with Casey's soul, also appeared, and Casey was forced to choose between retrieving her soul or letting Strange die. She attacked Silver Dagger, but was unable to overpower him, and had to use the spell she was taught to remove his dagger. Doctor Strange returned to the scene to find Silver Dagger unconscious and Casey being dragged to another dimension since she broke the agreement by using the removal spell to save his life. As she vanished she thanked Strange for the adventure and told him not to worry. Her glasses fell to the ground and shattered as she disappeared. Larry was freed with Casey's soul in hand, and Strange noticed it still burned bright enough to indicate that she still had a chance. He vowed to bring her back.

At this time Larry, trapped in another dimension with Casey's soul, also appeared, and Casey was forced to choose between retrieving her soul or letting Strange die. She attacked Silver Dagger, but was unable to overpower him, and had to use the spell she was taught to remove his dagger. Doctor Strange returned to the scene to find Silver Dagger unconscious and Casey being dragged to another dimension since she broke the agreement by using the removal spell to save his life. As she vanished she thanked Strange for the adventure and told him not to worry. Her glasses fell to the ground and shattered as she disappeared. Larry was freed with Casey's soul in hand, and Strange noticed it still burned bright enough to indicate that she still had a chance. He vowed to bring her back.
powers: Casey is capable of using a displacement spell that sends items to another dimension.
abilities: Casey had an innate magical ability that would allow her to use magic.

casey miller.name: Casey Miller
casey miller.origin: Casey Miller was a rodeo manager, who was against Johnny Blaze's decision to jump Copperhead Canyon; he nevertheless warned him about Snake Dance, a medicine man who was stirring up the Apache tribe .; The next day Blaze was missing, so Casey sent Sam Silvercloud to look out for him with his girlfriend Roxanne Simpson. As they both were still missing hours before the show, Casey eventually let Bart Slade perform in his stead .

cash collins.name: Cash Collins
cash collins.origin: Cash Collins was the leader of the Six-Gun Syndicate, a gang of outlaws that were active during the days of the American Frontier. Collins was smitten by Betty Baxter, the daughter of wealthy rancher Olin Baxter. When Collins came courting for her, Olin Baxter sent Collins away. Furious, Collins had Betty kidnapped and taken to his gang's hideout. Olin went out looking for his daughter to try and liberate her, crossing paths with Kid Colt. Learning of Olin's plight, Kid Colt agreed to get Betty back for him. Tracking down the gang, Kid Colt used his status as a wanted outlaw to convince Collins to allow him to join their gang. Colt was taken back to the shack they hid out in and he was introduced to Boots, an elderly member of the gang who was charged with keeping watch on Betty. Collins and his men then organized a bank robbery, but Kid Colt managed to avoid participation by making his horse Steel pretend to have a limp. However, Collins did not trust Kid Colt and followed him back to camp. There he caught Kid Colt, and Boots (whom Kid Colt convinced to help) attempting to free Betty. Collins got the drop on them, but agreed to draw cards to wager and see who would take Betty. However, Collins cheated, using an ace up his sleeve to win the match. Boots spotted this, and when Collins attempted to shoot Kid Colt, the Kid shot the gun from his hand. Kid Colt and Boots then took Betty and fled. However, Betty woke up and not understanding what was going on cried for help, drawing the rest of the gang after them. As they fled into the woods, Boots took a fatal gun shot wound and died, convincing Betty of their good intentions. However, Collins soon found them and gut shot Kid Colt. Before Collins could make Betty his prisoner once more, Kid Colt shot Collins right between the eyes killing him.

casiolena.name: Casiolena
casiolena.origin: Casiolena is the latest in a line of Asgardian sorceresses of considerable skill with the same name. She has been shown to fare well in battle against the Enchantress and Doctor Strange. thumb|left|Queen Casiolena Enchantress in particular has always been a contention point for Casiolena, with her banishment from Asgard occurring after she was mistaken for Amora and subsequently made a scene during a dinner. Casiolena has served as a queen of her new realm, and got the upper hand on Enchantress by seducing her long-time consort the Executioner, making her angry. Later, the Defenders found themselves transported to Casiolena's realm after their battle with the Nameless One. They were taken by surprise and quickly defeated by Casiolena's forces, led by the Executioner and Fragon. They were placed in Casiolena's dungeon where they met the Black Knight, the Enchantress, and an insane Barbara Norriss. The Enchantress transformed Norriss into the Asgardian warrior, the Valkyrie, who helped the group escape and renew their attack on Casiolena's forces. While the Valkyrie restrained Casiolena (as she is unable to hurt a woman), the Enchantress blasted her with bolts of mystical energy, seemingly killing her. Sent to Valhalla, Casiolena would return as an ally of Ollerus the Unmerciful, a dead and unworthy Asgardian warrior who planned to usurp Hela's position and become the new Asgardian God of Death. She helped Ollerus' plan of bringing the Defenders to his aid by splitting Brunnhilde and Norriss again, and making the latter pose as Valkyrie, using a fake Aragorn created by Casiolena. She even asked Ollerus to recruit first "a fair-haired man" in New York City to add to his army. However, once the true Valkyrie broke free, the Defenders rallied with Hela's forces against the forces of Ollerus and, when the Hulk destroyed Ollerus' mountain, proved triumphant. Many years later, Casiolena and her henchman Poppo the Cunning managed to break free from Niffleheim and mount a base on an abandoned hospital at Roosevelt Island. She started recruiting superpowered people for an army that would help her get control of Midgard. One of her minions, Bailey, revealed Hellcat, one of the Defenders who foiled her decades prior, was also looking to help the gifted. Casiolena then announced that anyone who joined her ranks would be rewarded, while ordering Bailey to capture her old foe. Bailey returns as the prisoner of Hellcat and Valkyrie, leading an angry Casiolena to render them all prisoner in a magic cage. Casiolena then showed her recruits wrecking havoc around New York city, explaining that the young and vulnerable minions enroll following her promise to give them magic to solve their own problems - something Casiolena could not do given she is an Asgardian exile, but "they do not know that" - and the chaos would help distract possible heroes. After Casiolena ordered Poppo to restrain Aragorn and the prisoners, the latter part ended leading to Poppo being gagged with tape. Following Hellcat comparing Casiolena to Enchantress, the sorceress threw a fit and attacked the prisoners and Poppo with her magic. Suddenly, Hellcat's friends She-Hulk and Ian Soo broke into the facility riding on Aragorn, and She-Hulk tackled Casiolena. As Poppo declined on helping Casiolena, the sorceress tried to kill him with a boulder made out of debris, being stopped by Ian's telekinesis. Hellcat then pounced on Casiolena, defeating the Asgardian, as Valkyrie and She-Hulk helped contain her. Casiolena tried to convince Ian into joining him, but he declined, and then She-Hulk told that Casiolena's army abandoned her: using her legal knowledge, she convinced one of the recruits that Casiolena's magic could not solve financial problems people such as him and Bailey wanted to fix, and he called the others to stop the mayhem. Poppo revealed he was the one who called for help, tired of Casiolena's grumpy behavior and all the bad experiences she forced on him. Casiolena tried to berate Hellcat's plan to help powered people saying "there are those within whom there is no good to find", to which Patsy replied that compassion is not a weakness and she will always try to find the best in people, and that unlike Casiolena "I know the difference between being a villain and making a mistake". Valkyrie then carried the tied Casiolena and Poppo in Aragorn's back, promising to return once the sorceress was dealt with.

casper jones.name: Casper Jones
casper jones.origin: In the 1920s, May Dusa was a famed photographer not only known for her work but also known for her peculiar habit: she never let herself be seen, always keeping a black hood around her head. Casper Jones, at one of her photo shows, decided to rob her, so he scheduled a photo session with her. The next day, just as Casper began to open her safe, May called him into her photography room. Casper revealed his true purpose and pulled a gun on her, threatening to shoot if she did not reveal her face. Despite protesting, May Dusa removed her hood, turning Casper to stone and revealing her true identity as the Medusa of Greek legend.

casper whimpley.name: Casper Whimpley
casper whimpley.origin: A henpecked husband, Casper Whimpley took on the guise of the Killer Clown, attacking women in the Los Angeles area. After killing three women, he was interrupted in the act of killing a fourth by the super-heroine Spider-Woman, who saved his victim and took her to hospital. The Killer Clown followed Spider-Woman to the home she shared with her friend Lindsay McCabe, and when Jessica stepped out to the store, he attacked Lindsay, thinking she was Spider-Woman. Jessica returned during the attack and drove the Killer Clown off, and took Lindsay to hospital. Thinking the Killer Clown would attack Lindsay again, Jessica lay in wait, and when he did indeed attack, Jessica fought and apprehended him.

cassandra hydra.name: Cassandra (Hydra)
cassandra hydra.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 11
cassandra hydra.origin: An agent of Hydra and ally (and probable lover) of Baron Wolfgang von Strucker when he staged his attack against the seceded Hydra branch Genesis Coalition. When the Genesis Coalition stole a mobile base from Hydra, Cassandra tracked it to the Balkans and reported to Strucker. Strucker ordered Cassandra to hire a non-affiliated team to recover the base without killing anyone, because the Genesis Coalition was at that time more a problem to Hydra's enemies than to Hydra itself. He also rewarded her with a kiss. Cassandra promptly hired the mercenary team Next Wave, but they failed. Strucker decided to punish Cassandra for this failure.

cassandra ferlenghetti.name: Cassandra Ferlenghetti
cassandra ferlenghetti.origin: Cassandra Ferlenghetti is a secretary for Harry Osgood, a talent agent who once managed Dazzler (Alison Blaire) and her band. As Osgood's secretary, she would screen visitors coming to see Osgood. In her first recorded appearance, she attempted to bar Alison Blaire from meeting with her employer, until she was distracted by the Beast. She had ever been a loyal secretary to Osgood, although she did not always approve of his client base. She was still employed by Osgood when Dazzler ceased association with him and his agency. Cassandra was not fond of Dazzler, rarely missing an opportunity to disparage her, which the singer attributed to professional jealousy. But her dislike of the Dazzler was surpassed by her open contempt for her field manager/bodyguard Lance, rebuffing his frequent romantic overtures. She once even managed a tepid compliment of Dazzler's performance when she was being criticized by Lance. When Osgood terminated his association with Dazzler, Cassandra continued to disparage the singer. Lance had finally had enough and angrily berated Cassie for her jealousy, before storming out of the office.

cassandra gillespie.name: Cassandra Gillespie
cassandra gillespie.origin: Cassandra Gillespie was the daughter of a weapons manufacturer rival of Howard Stark. Because of her mother's status, Cassandra was constantly escorted by bodyguards. As part of a plan to get information on Howard Stark, Cassandra's mother had her draw the attention of Howard's son Tony when he was studying at the University of Cambridge. After weeks of having Cassandra on his sights, Tony approached her during a party. In the middle of a scuffle, Tony and Cassandra slipped past her bodyguards. They eventually caught up to them and took her back. thumb|left|Young Cassandra The following days, Tony and Cassandra got to know each other better, causing her to develop real feelings for him. She eventually invited Tony to have dinner with her family. At the end of the evening, Tony and the Gillespies were attacked by Hydra forces, who had targeted Cassandra's mother because she had "betrayed" their cause. Stark managed to take a gun from one of the Gillespies' fallen bodyguards and kill a Hydra soldier who had Cassandra's mother at gun point; however, Cassandra's father, Giorgio, was allegedly severely wounded during the shootout. After learning of Tony's involvement with the Gillespie, Howard forced his son to return to America, but Tony still managed to slip away and travel to England off the grid in order to reunite with Cassandra. The two lovers ran away to navigate the oceans in a sailboat. During their cruise, Cassandra confessed to Tony that while she held feelings for him, their relationship had started as a ploy of her mother. Tony docked in the port of Auckland, New Zealand and stormed off the boat to get away from Cassandra, who tried to convince her that her feelings were real, to no avail. Forces of S.H.I.E.L.D. led by Howard Stark soon appeared on the bay to recover Tony and arrest Cassandra. They were interrupted by an assault from Hydra forces, which abducted Cassandra during a shoot-out with S.H.I.E.L.D. That was the last Tony saw of Cassandra for decades. Twenty years later, Tony Stark, as the super hero Iron Man, crossed paths with Cassandra when he was trying to find out about his true parentage, following the discovery that Howard wasn't his biological father. Cassandra's Mandroids managed to catch Iron Man by surprise and knocked him down. When Cassandra left the scene and had the Mandroids deal with Tony, Stark surrendered and let them take his suit. Gillespie's men brought Stark's armor to their boss at her compound, unaware that his advanced technology allowed him to use an undetectable tracker to find Cassandra's whereabouts. Equipped with a spare suit, Tony confronted Cassandra, and tried to force her to reveal any information she could possibly know about his father, considering his investigation led him to her. Cassandra revealed that she didn't know anything, a fact the sensors of Stark's armor confirmed as true. Gillespie's Mandroids arrived to the scene and surrounded the compound. Stark stalled for time until his A.I. assistant Friday could hack into their systems and cause the Mandroids to fire at and strike down each other. Cassandra attempted to escape, but she was intercepte in her car by Friday, who was controlling the armor the Mandroids had previously confiscated. Gillespie was subsequently arrested by S.H.I.E.L.D. agents.

cassandra kaufman.name: Cassandra Kaufman
cassandra kaufman.origin: When Cassandra discovered she was pregnant, she left Tod Kaufman because he was working for Hydra, and she didn't want their daughter to know her father was a monster. Cassandra's daughter turned out to be a mutant with razor pointed spikes sprouting from various parts of her body. At some point, she contracted a rare blood disease and required a bone marrow transplant to survive. To save her life, Cyclops dispatched Wolverine and X-Force to infiltrate Hydra Base 2994 and kidnap General Kaufman. X-Force forcibly brought Kaufman to Saint Francis Memorial Hospital in San Francisco were they explained his daughter's illness and the need for his bone marrow. Before he could reply, Hydra stormed into the hospital to extract Kaufman. Without time to give a proper sample, Kaufman allowed Wolverine to cut off his left arm, before leaving. Presumably, with the bone marrow from her father, she recovered from her illness.
