chameleon breese.name: Chameleon (Breese)
chameleon breese.origin: thumb|left|Beese Breese was a bank robber who led a mob under the name of the Chameleon in 1945. He obtained a job at Jonathan Mortimer's mortuary as an assistant for the purposes of digging a tunnel between the mortuary and the bank next door. In order to dig this tunnel, Breese created a fake organization called the Fraternity of Fat Fellows, a group that supposedly provided aid for overweight men. Then placing an add looking for a secretary that fit Mortimer's exact height and weight, Breese convinced Mortimer to apply for the position. This gave the Chameleon and his men plenty of time to dig the tunnel while Mortimer was away on his Fraternity duties. When the tunnel was completed, Breese had the Fraternity suddenly dissolved and shut down. When Mortimer went to confirm this, he was tossed off the property by the landlord, attracting the attention of Captain America and Bucky who decided to investigate what they first believed to be an elaborate prank. Spotting the two heroes snooping around the mortuary, the Chameleon had his men try to gun them down in a speeding truck. However, Cap and Bucky jumped on board and forced the shooter to reveal who his employer was. As the driver bailed out, the truck drove off a bridge while Cap and Bucky bailed out. Assuming that Captain America was killed, the Chameleon and his gang then began plotting the next part of their operation when Cap's continued searching around the property set off his alarm. Ordering his men to hide in coffins, Breese doffed his disguised and pretended to be sick in bed. However, when Captain America and Bucky came to question him, Cap noticed that Breese was still wearing his shoes. Ultimately discovering Breese's plot, Cap and Bucky attempted to stop the Chameleon and his men from making their robbery. The heroes were then knocked out and left tied to a conveyor belt leading to a furnace to die. Cap managed to short out the conveyor and free himself and Bucky and then stop the Chameleon and his gang. Cap then unmasked the Chameleon, revealing him to Breese and then turned him over to the authorities. The Chameleone's subsequent activities are unknown.

chan liuchow.name: Chan Liuchow
chan liuchow.origin: While still a teenager, Chan used ancient knowledge to awaken Fin Fang Foom to destroy the occupying communist army in China, Within a cave he found Fin Fang Foom. Chan brought with him two herbs one that would awaken the dragon, and another to send it back to sleep. After the dragon awoke Chan threatened to send it back to sleep causing Fin Fang Foom to chase him, destroying the army in the process. Luring the dragon back to the cave, Chan used the over herb to put the dragon back to sleep. Later in life after becoming a Professor of Chinese history he joined the Legion of Night, to fight the demon Aan Taanu, who had possessed Fin-Fang Foom. Chan battled the demon's hordes while others succeeded in banishing the demon.

chance walker.name: Chance Walker
chance walker.origin: Chance is the father of eco-terrorist Tess Walker. He was also the sheriff of a logging community. During this time, there were a number of mysterious deaths due to sabotage in the camps. One day the loggers had attacked and beaten a mysterious stranger who appeared savage and menacing: a brainwashed Sub-Mariner. Chance arrested Namor and investigated the situation. Finding that Namor was not at fault, he released Namor from custody. Namor stayed in the community with Chance's daughter Tess. Namor admired the nobility and fairness of Chance Walker; and when the town was attacked and he saw Chance was in danger, he rushed to his defense.

chance white.name: Chance White
chance white.origin: Chance White was a corrupt media mogul, who produced television shows for his network GWN such as "Jump the Shark", in which celebrities literally jump over a tank of water containing a shark. Deadpool intruded his headquarters in order to get the money the media mogul owed him from a contract. Deadpool managed to get to White's penthouse, and the door of his panic room was blew up by the mercenary despite facing heavy resistance from Chance's private army. He was hit and tackled out of a window, safely landing in the bouncy castle after entering the sewers by a narrow inlet. When Deadpool was distracted, the Marauders sneak up on him and took White. The producer informed the Marrauder's leader Mr. Sinister that his satellites were under the supervillain's control. Sinister ordered Blockbuster to kill Chance as he was no longer useful, which angered Deadpool for making him lose his money.

chancellor exchequer beltane.name: Chancellor Exchequer Beltane
chancellor exchequer beltane.origin: thumb|left|150pxBeltane served as the Chancellor Exchequer of Latveria, acting as the chief financial minister under the rule of Doctor Doom. In his position overseeing the nation’s banking system, he secretly orchestrated financial arrangements with several powerful criminal organizations, including Black Spectre, A.I.M., Agence Byzantine, Hydra, and Secret Empire. These groups were compiling vast amounts of intelligence and financial records into a device known as the Omegadrive. Beltane intended to use this information to facilitate massive financial transactions, laundering and routing the organizations’ funds through Latveria’s banking system to generate enormous wealth for the nation. His plans collapsed when the vigilante Daredevil stole the Omegadrive before the funds could be transferred. Furious at the loss, Beltane arranged for Daredevil to be forcibly transported to Latveria. Working with Dr. Hantmarr, he oversaw the development of the Ganzfield Mist, a gas designed to eliminate all sensory perception while introducing nanites into the brain. Daredevil was placed inside a containment chamber where Beltane personally confronted him, releasing the experimental gas and waiting for the hero to inhale it. Afterward, Daredevil was released and immediately attempted to escape, fighting through guards while demanding to know what had been done to him. Beltane ordered the soldiers to kill him, but Daredevil managed to break through a window and flee the building. The hero was eventually recaptured after the gas rendered him unable to rely on his senses. Beltane then ordered medical personnel to analyze Daredevil’s radar sense and attempt to reproduce it through experimentation while he remained under observation. After several days of sensory deprivation, Beltane authorized preparations for a vivisection procedure. Daredevil escaped his hospital room before the operation could begin, prompting a renewed pursuit that ended with him cornered on the roof. Beltane personally fired at Daredevil and instructed the guards to shoot to wound rather than kill. However, Daredevil had already activated his Avengers identification card, summoning help. Iron Man arrived and intercepted Beltane’s gunfire, throwing the Latverian official aside. During the confrontation, Beltane admitted the experiments performed on Daredevil but insisted that Latveria had no extradition treaty that would permit Iron Man to remove him from the country. Iron Man responded by striking Beltane with a repulsor blast.

chandi.name: Chandi
chandi.origin: thumb|left|The mostly invisible Chandi Chandi originated from Ethiopia and was brought to England to work as an assistant to Basil Drake. Drake went insane when he was refused the right to marry Ellen Chadwick, the daughter of Sir John Chadwick. Inventing an invisibility potion, he used it to render Chandi mostly invisible (option to leave Chandi's hands visible, likely to enhance the terror of his victims) and have the servant strangle members of the Chadwick family to death. These murders prompted Sir John to call on his American colleague Professor Philo Zog to aid in solving the murders with his robot invention Electro. On Zog's first night there, Chandi attacked again. When Electro was incapable of stopping the attacker initially, Zog rushed into the next room and winged the invisible attacker with a bullet, sending Chandi fleeing back to Drake's home. Following Chandi there, Electro strangled Chandi into submission before going to confront Drake. However, Drake, fearful of the robot, committed suicide instead of allowing himself to be captured. Later, when investigating the scene, Zog and his friends were attacked by the now fully visible Chandi, who Zog was forced to shoot dead.

chandra centaurian.name: Chandra (Centaurian)
chandra centaurian.origin: Chandra was one of many Centaurians that lived on New Xeron. When the Space Parasite arrived on New Xeron, he took over the planet and fed off the life energies of its inhabitants. Chandra was the only one who chose to resist the Parasite's hold and aided Terrax, Paibok, and the Delinquent in fighting and killing the Parasite at the cost of her own life.

chandra ku.name: Chandra Ku
chandra ku.origin: While awaiting the next visit of the Celestials to Earth, the deities of the planet decided to find a way to convince the visitors that humankind was worthy of survival. Over the span of ten centuries, these deities selected twelve ordinary men and women as a sample of humanity. Each of the chosen had mastered one of humanity's greatest fields of achievement. Each of these humans was endowed with godlike powers. Chandra Ku was an 18th-century Zulu girl. At a relatively young age,she demonstrated great skills as a craftswoman. When she was 13-years-old, Chandra was chosen by the deities as a member of their sample of humanity. Chandra has grown to prefer self-isolation and meditation to interaction with others. She is a loner among her fellow Young Gods and reportedly rarely speaks.

chandradat ramnarain.name: Chandradat Ramnarain
chandradat ramnarain.origin: Chandradat Ramnarain helped C.I.D. agent Nate Hale arrest Top. Ramnarain participated in the Paul Revere mission where Ralph Marchese was killed. He also participated in the Tay Ninh Province mission where Mike Albergo was killed in action. During the Vietnam War, Ramnarain used to conduct illicit trade with the locals. Ramnarain later associated with Casey Brown. In March of 1967, Ramnarain was introduced by Sergeant Polkow to Lt. Alarnick, their new platoon leader. Ramnarain was eventually captured by the Việt Cộng during a mission in an enemy village.

chandu.name: Chandu
chandu.origin: Chandu is a 12th Century mystic associated with Black John and Modred. Chandu helped capture and imprison King Richard the Lion Heart and opposed The Black Knight and the Defenders when they attempted to free Richard. Chandu is able to summon extremely powerful Gnomes from his mystical flames and smoke. These Gnomes have the power to fell the Silver Surfer and stand toe to toe with the Hulk. Unfortunately, the Sub-Mariner determined that the Gnomes disintegrate when exposed to water. In modern times, Chandu and a host of other mystics calling themselves the Convocation of Wizards attacked Avengers Mansion looking for Doctor Druid. They wanted Druid's secrets of eternal youth, as well as the Black Knight's Ebony Blade. During this assault on Avengers Mansion, Chandu fought the Vision and defeated him with his magical attacks. During this same attack, another member of the Convocation of Wizards named Le Sabre forced Hercules to surrender by taking a hostage. Chandu then used the Vision's body to bind Hercules. Sersi reformed the damaged Vision into three miniature versions of himself who then went on to defeat Chandu. Sersi then restored the Vision to his proper form.

chang madripoor.name: Chang (Madripoor)
chang madripoor.origin: Chang was an employee of Landau, Luckman & Lake's offices located in Madripoor. He dealt with the personal finances of Logan, the mutant known as Wolverine. Early on his his career as an adventurer, Wolverine realized that Landau, Luckman & Lake was more than it seemed when going to Chang to collect some of his money from the agency. Peeping through a keyhole, Logan was surprised as Chang entered a disguised warp gate with a gun only to return moments later with a different gun, appearing as though he had been gone for weeks. However, he would not learn the full scope of LL&L's operations until later. More recently, Logan -- operating in Madripoor in his Patch identity -- trusted Chang to keep his friends Jessica Drew and Lindsay McCabe safe from General Coy. However, Chang's office would be attacked by Coy's enforcers Roughouse and Bloodsport, killing Chang in the attack.

chang lam.species: Human Mutate transformed into a large monster
chang lam.origin: Chang Lam was a Chinese scientist who was working to create a more efficient version of the Hulk. When he believed his research was complete, he used it on himself. When he transformed he retained control of his permanently enhanced form because of his lack of mental disorders. He was, at the time of its inception, serving with the Liberators. He was last seen in the Liberators' fight with the Ultimates, battling with Hulk, a fight he lost, after the Hulk pulled his arms off, then punched the top of head off, after which the Hulk ate Lam's remains.

changamire.name: Changamire
changamire.origin: Changamire was a Wakandan philosopher, the handpicked tutor for King T'Chaka's royal court, and the personal mentor of Queen Ramonda. His pacific yet anti-monarchical beliefs caused him to be exiled from the Golden City. He became a scholar at the Hekima Shulē in Birnin Azzaria, where he continued teaching his gospel. Based on Changamire's doctrine, his former pupil Tetu amassed a revolutionary force known as the People in order to overthrow King T'Challa and wage war against his reign. Because of this, Changamire was visited by Ramonda, who wanted to investigate any possible link between Changamire and the People. However, Changamire repudiated this brutal revolution, due to having renounced violence. Tetu later personally invited Changamire to join the People, but the old scholar refused, opposing the People's violent methods and expressing sorrow that his teachings paved the path to such bloodshed, ultimately accusing Tetu of being not too different from the same tyranny he opposed. When the People marched towards the Golden City, T'Challa visited Changamire to have him join his side. The Black Panther agreed that Wakanda needed to change, but not by the People's violent and bloody hand. Changamire initially claimed to be unable to offer advice to Black Panther, but T'Challa convinced him that he was the lesser evil. The Black Panther was a hero at heart who did not take joy from domination, unlike Tetu. Changamire conceded T'Challa's points, and joined his side. When Tetu and the People marched towards the Golden City, Black Panther had Changamire speak out against Tetu's atrocities and broadcast it through the Kimoyo Beads. Changamire's speech greatly affected the People's efficiency, causing a large amount of their soldiers to break free from Zenzi's mental manipulation. After T'Challa - who had been transported across the Prime Marvel Universe to where Wakanda had become a tyrannical intergalactic empire - returned home, Changamire was taken over by the symbiote that had formerly belonged to the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda's deceased god-emperor N'Jadaka. Indwelled by the Emperor's consciousness, Changamire recruited Tetu and Zenzi in order to take revenge against T'Challa and once again attempt to conquer Wakanda.

Tetu later personally invited Changamire to join the People, but the old scholar refused, opposing the People's violent methods and expressing sorrow that his teachings paved the path to such bloodshed, ultimately accusing Tetu of being not too different from the same tyranny he opposed. When the People marched towards the Golden City, T'Challa visited Changamire to have him join his side. The Black Panther agreed that Wakanda needed to change, but not by the People's violent and bloody hand. Changamire initially claimed to be unable to offer advice to Black Panther, but T'Challa convinced him that he was the lesser evil. The Black Panther was a hero at heart who did not take joy from domination, unlike Tetu. Changamire conceded T'Challa's points, and joined his side. When Tetu and the People marched towards the Golden City, Black Panther had Changamire speak out against Tetu's atrocities and broadcast it through the Kimoyo Beads. Changamire's speech greatly affected the People's efficiency, causing a large amount of their soldiers to break free from Zenzi's mental manipulation. After T'Challa - who had been transported across the Prime Marvel Universe to where Wakanda had become a tyrannical intergalactic empire - returned home, Changamire was taken over by the symbiote that had formerly belonged to the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda's deceased god-emperor N'Jadaka. Indwelled by the Emperor's consciousness, Changamire recruited Tetu and Zenzi in order to take revenge against T'Challa and once again attempt to conquer Wakanda.

changdao.name: Changdao
changdao.origin: Changdao, also known as The Saber was a crime boss in Madripoor that the Invisible Woman and Black Widow went to go see to learn some information involving the whereabouts of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Aidan Tintreach. Changdao said that he would only give the location if Susan was able to beat him in a drinking game. Susan was ready to participate but Changdao told her she wasn't going to be facing him but instead his subordinate, Gōngniú. After nine rounds of whiskey shots, Susan beat Gōngniú as he passed out on the floor in a drunken stupor. But it was revealed that Changdao poisoned Gōngniú's drinks thus killing him while he called on his bodyguards to do the same thing to the women. But Susan made quick work with the guards as Natasha grabbed Changdao by the collar wondering who could intimidate someone as vile as the Saber. But before Changdao was able to finish talking he was shot in the head by an unknown assailant escaping on a motorcycle.

channok.name: Channok
channok.origin: Channok, Keeper of the Forbidden Spells was a demon who was visited by Doctor Strange who need to find a divine restoration spell to heal the nerve damage in his hands so he could perform brain surgery on a boy who was in a car accident. Channok gave Strange permission to search his library but he knew what spell was needed for such a thing, Uthurvan's Invocation. Channok gave him the Book of Even Odds freely but told Strange that if he used it to heal the damage there was an equal chance that it would sever his bond to magic leaving his realm undefended from the supernatural. After Strange looked at the writings in the book he headed back to Earth but not before Channok warned him that there will be a price to pay for this gift.

chao sima.name: Chao Sima
chao sima.origin: ===Death of Leiko Wu=== After Leiko Wu, Chao Sima's lover, was killed, he offered his help to Shang-Chi investigating the death. Shang-Chi, who had clashed with him in the past, did not believe he had been Leiko's lover, nor did he believe he was a changed man, and refused his help. Believing that White Dragon had something to do with her death, Skull-Crusher gave him the address to his club. Even though Shang-Chi didn't trust him, he decided to follow him, without his notice. When Shang-Chi went to White Dragon's castle after a previous confrontation, Skull-Crusher revealed himself and told Shang-Chi he was almost sure what White Dragon plan was, but they needed to act fast. They infiltrated the castle, and eventually entered a room where they found various disappeared clan leaders heads, spiked in a ritualistic fashion on a circle of swords. White Dragon then appeared and confronted them, but lost. Soon after, Shang-Chi's brother Midnight Sun appeared, shackled both of them with his powers, and revealed that he had orchestrated the whole plan. Midnight Sun, still needing the last two clan members for the ritual to be complete, killed Skull-Crusher and White Dragon, who offered himself to the ritual. When Midnight Sun performed the ritual, instead of giving him power over all the clans, it resurrected Leiko Wu. Leiko, using her newly acquired powers, summoned the spirit of Skull-Crusher and the other clan leaders who pulled Midnight Sun into the underworld. Before disappearing Skull-Crusher gave Leiko one last kiss.

chaos titan.name: Chaos (Titan)
chaos titan.species: Artificial Titan, later transformed into a cosmic being
chaos titan.origin: Chaos was created by ISAAC, the computer on Titan, when it was corrupted by Thanos. After emerging from his Life-Bath, he began absorbing everything around him, including Captain Marvel. Marvel was sent into the dimension of the creature called Tartarus. Marvel was able to destroy Tartarus while Elysius and Drax the Destroyer defeated Chaos by attacking his heart. When Captain Marvel returned, he damaged ISAAC enough where it was no longer a threat. Later, Chaos was resurrected along with several other villains by ISAAC with his powers increased tenfold and sent against Captain Marvel, Drax, and the Titans. After knocking out Drax, Marvel was about to unleash enough power to knock out Chaos. Chaos attended the Devil's Advocacy along with many other demonic creatures to discuss the attack on Earth by the Serpent.

charasulla.name: Charasulla
charasulla.origin: The New Mutants discovered a furry green alien called Charasūlla and fought with him. Despite their best efforts, the New Mutants struggled to overcome the alien until Lila began playing a riff on her guitar that caused his weapons and armor to explode and rendered him helpless before disappearing in a burst of light. Lila Cheney was soon contacted by the alien Charasūlla who appeared to have made a deal with her related to enslaving Earth's inhabitants. He sought a private arrangement with her but she insisted they followed the deal as prescribed but was soon betrayed by one of her band mates who lowered the defenses of their location and contacted the alien himself to greenlight an invasion of the sphere. The invasion by Charasūlla and his fellow Vrakanín commenced just as the other New Mutants arrived to the sphere.

chargazel.name: Chargazel
chargazel.origin: Chargazel was the leader of the Raiders, a band of marauders on the hunt for a group of alien refugees whose species had the natural ability to materialize their prayers into diamonds. These aliens were under the protection of the Ravagers, and kept going from planet to planet to escape their tormentors. The Raiders eventually located the refugees on Ego the Living Planet, where the Ravagers had been found by the Asgardians of the Galaxy. Before attacking the refugee camp, the Raiders set up a device on Ego's moon, Alter Ego. This device allowed Chargazel to compromise Alter Ego's behavior, thus influence Ego's actions since his will was susceptible to Alter Ego. Under Chargazel's influence, Ego began to attack all creatures on its surface, refugees, Raiders, Asgardians, and Ravagers alike. The Asgardians and the Ravagers tried to protect the refugees and fend off the Raiders while evading Ego's environmental hazards. After Ego managed to warn the heroes about the Raiders' meddling, Angela flew up to Alter Ego and threatened the Raiders into deactivating their device, killing and dismembering Chargazel in the process.

charity brown.name: Charity Brown
charity brown.origin: Charity Brown was a young puritan woman living in Salem, Massachusetts, in the late seventeenth century. She found herself entranced by dreams of Count Dracula, who was seeking a pure, innocent bride to add to his harem, and willingly accepted him. She was seen dancing sensually in the forest by her guardian, Goodman Alden, who attempted to assault her. She fought him off and escaped, and in revenge, he accused her of witchcraft. Because Dracula had placed his mark upon her, she was found guilty and sentenced to death. Dracula arrived in America to claim her, but came too late to prevent her hanging. In revenge, he killed Alden and cursed the town.

charlemagne agent.name: Charlemagne (Agent)
charlemagne agent.origin: Charlemagne was, at one time, a freelance intelligence agent. She had taken a job for the KGB. It was a mission that Logan had protested, but Charlie insisted and her handler double-crossed her. Charlie called for Logan's help and he understood that it was serious. After fifty Soviet operatives couldn't take them down, they sent in KGB agents that had been undercover for years and Wolverine's berserker rage finished them all. After the slaughter, all that was left was a little heart shaped pendant. After many years, Charlie did too many jobs and knew too much and was marked for death by multiple agencies. charles amundson.name: Charles Amundson
charles amundson.origin: Glitch was a hacker who was contacted by Spymaster to assist his Espionage Elite by hacking Iron Man's computer system. To this end he developed a suit that allowed his to hack Iron Man's suit. He was able to gain access to several of Iron Man's system and engaged parts of his armors. He attempted again, but this time the armor was controlled by an LMD which accidentally trapped his conscious inside the LMD. The LMD returned to Stark, but did not have a face, so Glitch went a blind rampage until it was destroyed by Stark. Glitch's consciousness returned to his body and returned to Spymaster. Iron Man followed, but Glitch captured him. Spymaster began to plan how he would use the armor to make a fortune. Glitch was disgusted, and freed Iron Man who defeated the Espionage Elite. Glitch surrendered and was handed over to Nick Fury. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

charles barnabus.name: Charles Barnabus
charles barnabus.origin: Following the death of monster hunter Ulysses Bloodstone, vampire Charles Barnabus became the executor of Ulysses’ estate in Boston, Massachusetts. For years, he searched for a living heir to inherit Bloodstone’s wealth, and eventually discovered eighteen-year-old Elsa Bloodstone. Elsa and her mother, Elise, moved into the Bloodstone mansion, but Charles was careful to keep the true knowledge of Ulysses' lifestyle away from his daughter. Elsa eventually learned the truth on her own after encountering the mansion's caretaker, Adam. As Elsa found herself drawn into the world of the supernatural, Charles was forced to reveal himself as a vampire. A powerful breed of vampire known as the Nosferati captured several vampires including Dracula and Charles Barnabus. The Nosferati can only feed off of the blood of other vampires, and intended on keeping Dracula and Charles as a permanent immortal food source. Elsa and her friends raided the Nosferati headquarters freeing the two vampires. Following the defeat of the Nosferati, Charles returned with Elsa to Bloodstone Manor. Since then, Elise Bloodstone has converted the mansion into a curio museum. Charles Barnabus has developed a close bond with the woman and remains as part of the museum's staff.

charles barton.name: Charles Barton
charles barton.origin: thumb|220px|left|Charles in his childhood (left; Charles & right; his younger brother, Clint) ===Early Life=== Charles Bernard Barton (nicknamed Barney) was born on August 4th to Harold and Edith Barton. He grew up working in his father's butcher shop in Waverly, Iowa with his younger brother Clint. Their father was abusive, especially when he drank and continually beat the young boys. Barney taught Clint how to fight and helped him to improve his aim. Harold's drinking eventually cost him his life along with his wife when both died in a car accident, leaving the two boys orphans. The boys were placed in numerous foster homes, and when Clint turned 13, the boys ran away from one of them. The boys eventually came across a carnival. The two boys took up odd jobs at the Carson Carnival of Traveling Wonder as roustabouts, and both became impressed with one of the star performers, Jacques DuQuesne also known as the Swordsman. The Swordsman asked the boys if they wished to help in his act and while Barney declined, Clint jumped at the chance. After many successful shows, the Swordsman asked fellow performer Trickshot to train Clint in archery. At this point Barney accused Clint of being used by the Swordsman. Sometime later Barney was interested in obtaining his G.E.D. after getting a decent score on his SATs. Clint was only obsessed with the show and improving his archery skills. When Barney tried to persuade Clint to take an interest in his education, he was angered, the brothers argued, and Barney reminded him that he had his own life to lead. Barney became jealous and bitter for being overlooked by his idol. Later, when Clint was severely injured at the hands of the Swordsman for discovering his embezzlement scheme, Barney condemned his brother for not remaining loyal to his mentor. Barney became fed up with life at the carnival and decided to get a fresh start by joining the Army. He asked Clint to join him and again he declined. Barney told him the offer was still there and waited with hope at the bus depot. Barney got on the bus, saddened by the absence of his brother. Clint eventually turned up only to see the bus leave without him. right|thumb|200px After a successful career in the army, Barney joined the FBI. His first assignment as an agent was to go undercover as a bodyguard for a criminal called Marko. Coincidentally his brother Clint and Trickshot attempted to rob Marko's mansion. During the robbery Barney was shot with an arrow by his brother and when Clint learned what he had done, he was devastated. Clint refused to leave his brother's side and turned against Trickshot. Trickshot was angered by the betrayal, wounding Clint with an arrow and leaving. His next undercover assignment was to pose as a racketeer. He was approached by Egghead, who asked Barton to help finance his space station. Barton declined and called Egghead a nutcase; Egghead retaliated by sending a robot to kill him. Barton survived and sought out his brother Hawkeye, who was a member of the Avengers, informing him of Egghead's plans and accompanying the team to the space station. When Egghead used a paralysis ray on the Avengers, Barton sacrificed his life to destroy the ray-projector. After the funeral, Clint received a letter from FBI agent Allan Scofield revealing Barney's double life. The letter also revealed that Barney was aware of Clint's double life. left|thumb|200px ===Blindspot=== It was later revealed that Barney's body was taken by Egghead, who discovered there were faint vital signs and placed him in one of his accelerated healing chambers. When Egghead was eventually killed by Hawkeye in a final battle with the Avengers, the chamber was left lost and forgotten. Baron Zemo discovered the chamber, and holding a personal grudge against Hawkeye, he manipulated Barney to turn brother against brother. Baron Zemo then enlisted Hawkeye's own mentor Trickshot, who was once again suffering from cancer. Zemo recruited him to train Barney to be as proficient with a bow and arrow as his brother. When the training was complete, Trickshot was badly beaten and his cancer continued to spread. Barney then took the dying Trickshot to Avengers Tower as a message to Hawkeye. Sometime later while investigating his former mentor's death, Hawkeye was attacked by his brother, declaring himself the new Trickshot. Barney defeated his brother and took him to Baron Zemo. Zemo had the brothers duel to the death, but Hawkeye managed to best Trickshot in battle. Before teleporting away, Zemo transferred Trickshot's funds over to the winner, Hawkeye, then taunts the hero for turning his brother against him. Later in custody, Trickshot agreed to provide a bone marrow sample for transplant to save his brother's sight, but only so he could fight his brother again in the future. ===Dark Avengers=== After Osborn escaped the Raft, he decide to create a new H.A.M.M.E.R. organization and recruit an new team of Dark Avengers.
